Berkoordinasi dengan PBF Supervisor Agency dan pihak terkait dalam menjalankan aktivitas bisnis dan proses pengajuan pembiayaan. Membuat Laporan Aktivitas Harian (LAH) terkait aktivitas akuisisi dan maintenance agent, Direct Selling, Pre-Visit, serta aktivitas prospek lainnya.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Bertanggung jawab terhadap pencapaian target booking produk Dana Tunai dengan Jaminan Sertifikat/SHM (Leaseback SHM) dengan memperhatikan kualitas aplikasi. Melakukan akuisisi dan pengembangan calon debitur melalui Direct Selling maupun Referral/RO Debitur. Mengelola dan memastikan proses aplikasi yang berasal dari berbagai channel berjalan sesuai dengan ketentuan dan SLA perusahaan. Melakukan visit dan follow up kepada calon debitur/debitur potensial sesuai dengan assignment dari Supervisor. Mengkomunikasikan struktur pembiayaan kepada calon debitur berdasarkan hasil survey dan memastikan debitur memahami serta menyetujui struktur pembiayaan yang ditawarkan. Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen dan persyaratan pengajuan pembiayaan sesuai dengan ketentuan perusahaan. Melakukan follow up terhadap pending/T&C dokumen kepada debitur hingga persyaratan terpenuhi dan aplikasi dapat diproses. Menginformasikan hasil persetujuan atau penolakan aplikasi kepada debitur serta memberikan informasi terkait proses selanjutnya. Memastikan proses aplikasi berjalan dengan baik mulai dari pengajuan, survey, approval, akad hingga funding sesuai SLA yang ditetapkan. Melakukan koordinasi dengan Supervisor PBF dan pihak terkait untuk mendukung kelancaran proses pembiayaan. Melakukan collection handling untuk konsumen past due bersama Supervisor dan tim Collection sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Membuat Laporan Aktivitas Harian (LAH) terkait aktivitas visit, akuisisi, survey calon debitur, dan aktivitas lainnya.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About The Role This role will act as the central intelligence and quality engine of the Contact Center. This role is responsible for driving continuous improvement across customer operations by integrating workforce optimization, frontline quality governance, and data-driven customer insights As our Astronaut, your missions are: Pillar Management & Team Integration: Direct and align three core sub-functions: QA & Training, Customer Insight, and WFM. Ensuring data from Insights informs QA rubrics/Training curriculum, while WFM staffing aligns with complaint volume trends. Complaint Rate Reduction (Internal CX): Design and execute internal operational initiatives that directly lower contact and complaint rates by optimizing agent workflows, updating knowledge bases, improving First Contact Resolution (FCR), and targeting quality coaching. System & Process Redesign (External CX): Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Tech, Operations, Marketing) to eliminate systemic complaint drivers, resolving upstream product bugs, policy friction, and fulfillment delays. Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Governance: Establish structured RCA frameworks (5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA) using insight analytics and QA escalations to isolate recurring failure points across the end-to-end customer journey. Project Management & ROI Tracking: Own the project lifecycle for CX improvement workstreams, defining success metrics (e.g., % reduction in complaint volume, CSAT lift, ticket deflection) and presenting progress to CX leadership. Crisis & Escalation Leadership: Lead cross-departmental task forces during major operational disruptions to mitigate customer impact in real time.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this Position The Buyer Associate will be responsible for selecting and purchasing fruits & vegetables that meet Astro Farm’s quality, pricing, and availability requirements. The role requires strong product knowledge, hands-on market assessment, and close monitoring of supplier performance, PO fulfillment, and pricing to support efficient and reliable sourcing. Job Description: As our Astronaut, your missions are: Source and select fruits & vegetables based on Astro’s quality, quantity, and pricing requirements. Check product quality, freshness, specifications, and suitability before purchase. Compare product prices and conduct market price benchmarking to support the best purchasing decision. Monitor PO fulfillment and make sure products are delivered according to requirements. Monitor supplier performance, product consistency, and availability. Work closely with Upstream, Quality, and other relevant teams to solve product, pricing, or fulfillment issues. Maintain purchasing, pricing, and execution reports. For Pasar Induk Kramat Jati: Conduct regular visits to Pasar Induk Kramat Jati and other Pasar Induk when needed. Monitor daily market prices, product availability, and quality. Support product receive/reject decisions based on Astro’s quality standards. Be flexible to conduct market visits at night, following fresh produce arrival and trading activities. For Direct Importer: Evaluate imported fruits & vegetables based on quality, shelf life, origin, pricing, and specifications. Monitor import lead time and purchasing timelines. We are looking for a Procurement Supervisor who is confident in dealing with vendors, enjoys negotiation, pays attention to details, and can take ownership when things don't go according to plan. In this role, you will work closely with vendors and different teams across Billstone, handle both routine and project-based procurement, and help improve the way we work. If you enjoy turning procurement challenges into better deals, better processes, and better results, we'd love to meet you. Outcomes You’ll Be Responsible For : Manage daily procurement activities, from sourcing and purchasing to vendor coordination and documentation. Source and evaluate vendors based on price, quality, specifications, capability, and lead time. Negotiate pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead time, and other commercial terms. Monitor vendor performance and resolve quality issues, defects, claims, and delivery delays. Ensure PO and payment requests are accurate and properly processed in Odoo. Handle procurement needs from various departments, including project-based and urgent requests. Conduct product checks or vendor visits when required. Identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvement. Follow up on procurement issues and escalate major issues when necessary. What Great Looks Like in This Role : Procurement runs accurately, efficiently, and on time. Vendors consistently deliver according to agreed cost, quality, and timeline. Better commercial terms and cost-saving opportunities are identified. Potential issues are spotted early and resolved before they impact operations. Internal teams can rely on Procurement to get things done. Procurement processes become simpler, faster, and more effective over time. How You Work : You are confident in negotiation while maintaining strong vendor relationships. You make decisions based on cost, quality, lead time, and risk. You take ownership when things go wrong and focus on finding solutions. You are detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities. You follow up proactively and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You can adapt quickly when priorities change, including handling urgent requests. You are comfortable working both at your desk and on-site when needed. What You’ll Enjoy as Our Team : Incentives (quarterly) Tenure rewards & annual reviews Recognition & appreciation culture Well-being perks Your ideas matter and are rewarded All recruitment processes will be conducted online.

Pelaporan & Komunikasi: Menyusun dan mempresentasikan analisis, rekomendasi, serta wawasan (insight) terkait sistem pangkalan data kepada tim teknis maupun non-teknis.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Bertanggung jawab terhadap pencapaian target booking produk Dana Tunai dengan Jaminan Sertifikat/SHM (Leaseback SHM) dengan memperhatikan kualitas aplikasi. Melakukan akuisisi dan pengembangan calon debitur melalui Direct Selling maupun Referral/RO Debitur. Mengelola dan memastikan proses aplikasi yang berasal dari berbagai channel berjalan sesuai dengan ketentuan dan SLA perusahaan. Melakukan visit dan follow up kepada calon debitur/debitur potensial sesuai dengan assignment dari Supervisor. Melakukan survey dan analisa kelayakan pembiayaan terhadap calon debitur, termasuk melakukan pengecekan awal terhadap objek jaminan SHM. Menggali dan melakukan validasi informasi terkait calon debitur, kebutuhan pembiayaan, serta kondisi aset yang menjadi jaminan. Mengkomunikasikan struktur pembiayaan kepada calon debitur berdasarkan hasil survey dan memastikan debitur memahami serta menyetujui struktur pembiayaan yang ditawarkan. Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen dan persyaratan pengajuan pembiayaan sesuai dengan ketentuan perusahaan. Melakukan follow up terhadap pending/T&C dokumen kepada debitur hingga persyaratan terpenuhi dan aplikasi dapat diproses. Menginformasikan hasil persetujuan atau penolakan aplikasi kepada debitur serta memberikan informasi terkait proses selanjutnya. Memastikan proses aplikasi berjalan dengan baik mulai dari pengajuan, survey, approval, akad hingga funding sesuai SLA yang ditetapkan. Melakukan koordinasi dengan Supervisor PBF dan pihak terkait untuk mendukung kelancaran proses pembiayaan. Melakukan collection handling untuk konsumen past due bersama Supervisor dan tim Collection sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Membuat Laporan Aktivitas Harian (LAH) terkait aktivitas visit, akuisisi, survey calon debitur, dan aktivitas lainnya.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Business Relationship Development Program (BRDP) BCA Syariah merupakan program pengembangan bagi calon karyawan yang akan dididik secara komprehensif di bidang bisnis. Program ini memberikan kesempatan percepatan karier bagi lulusan universitas yang terpilih. Melalui program ini, BCA Syariah bertujuan menciptakan individu yang kompeten dan mampu berkontribusi dalam membangun BCA Syariah menjadi institusi keuangan syariah yang unggul. Setiap peserta akan mendapat kesempatan untuk mempelajari hal-hal baru dalam industri finansial, memahami ketentuan dan regulasi perbankan, serta merasakan secara langsung bagaimana bisnis perbankan dijalankan dengan menerapkan prinsip kepatuhan dan regulasi yang berlaku. Program ini mengkombinasikan pembelajaran melalui pengalaman, pembelajaran di kelas, dan pembelajaran melalui orang lain. Bagian terbesar dari program pengembangan ini dilaksanakan melalui kegiatan On the Job Training (OJT), dimana setiap peserta akan diarahkan dan didampingi oleh mentor yang andal dan berpengalaman di bidangnya.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Description We are looking for a detail-oriented System Analyst – Regulatory Reporting to analyze business requirements, support regulatory reporting systems, and ensure that reporting solutions meet applicable regulatory requirements and business needs, particularly within the banking or financial services industry. Key Responsibilities: Gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements related to regulatory reporting. Work closely with business users, compliance teams, regulatory reporting teams, developers, and QA teams. Analyze regulatory reporting processes, data flows, and system functionalities. Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Specifications, System Requirements Specifications (SRS), and process flow diagrams. Translate regulatory requirements into functional and technical specifications. Perform data mapping, data validation, and reconciliation to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency. Support system testing, including SIT and UAT, and assist in resolving issues identified during testing. Ensure regulatory reporting solutions comply with applicable regulations, internal policies, and reporting standards. Support system enhancements, issue investigation, and documentation updates.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: At Aleph, we design human experiences by asking the right questions. Here, you’d find a curious breed of creative engineers spread across the globe, specializing in craft, strategy, and technology. With a keen ear to the ground, we turn big dreams into user-first digital solutions by design. Through rigorous prototyping, close collaboration, and responsive engineering, we commit to creating a future that leaves our craft, community, and clients better than before. ​​We’re looking for a skilled and curious Product & UX Researcher to join our team and support the revamp of a major banking platform. You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional project squad alongside UI/UX Designers and the client’s Product and Business teams. Your role is to uncover user needs, pain points, and opportunities — and to champion those insights to shape the next generation of banking experiences. As the team’s Researcher, you will own the end-to-end research process and help guide both product and design decisions. You’ll also contribute to defining post-launch success metrics to ensure the solutions we create have measurable impact. Here are your key responsibilities: Collaborate with the internal project squad and the client’s stakeholders to define research goals and select the most effective approaches (interviews, FGDs, participatory design, usability testing, surveys, A/B testing, data analysis, etc). Translate business questions into focused research plans and activities that generate actionable insights. Lead end-to-end research: plan, recruit, conduct, analyze, and report — including managing research operations for the project. Present findings in clear, structured, and compelling formats (e.g., report documents, insight decks, or synthesis frameworks). Act as a user advocate in design discussions, participating in ideation and helping shape the UX. Co-define product success metrics and performance indicators with the team; help build a framework for ongoing tracking and optimization. Ensure all research activities adhere to ethical and legal standards, especially around handling sensitive customer and financial data.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About the Role Di Billstone, Anda akan memegang peran penting dalam menjaga kualitas dan keandalan proses keuangan perusahaan. Sebagai FAT Supervisor, Anda akan menjadi bagian dari tim yang memastikan financial process berjalan dengan baik, informasi yang dihasilkan dapat dipercaya, dan perusahaan memiliki pondasi keuangan yang kuat untuk terus berkembang. Peran ini cocok bagi Anda yang ingin mengambil ownership lebih besar, memiliki perhatian tinggi terhadap akurasi, serta tertarik untuk ikut meningkatkan cara kerja dan proses keuangan, bukan sekadar menjalankan rutinitas. Your Responsibilities 1. Financial Reporting & Accounting Validation Menyiapkan dan mereview laporan keuangan bulanan dan tahunan berbasis PSAK, dengan laporan bulanan selesai sebelum tanggal 5 setiap bulannya. Memvalidasi seluruh transaksi, jurnal, rekonsiliasi bank, AR/AP, serta dokumen pendukung secara menyeluruh. Mengidentifikasi discrepancy atau ketidaksesuaian transaksi dan memastikan tindak lanjut hingga terselesaikan. Menyiapkan data dan dokumen pendukung untuk kebutuhan audit internal maupun eksternal. 2. Tax Planning, Compliance & Vendor Audit Memastikan perhitungan, pembayaran, dan pelaporan PPh/PPN dilakukan secara akurat dan tepat waktu, dengan pembayaran sebelum tanggal 10 dan pelaporan sebelum tanggal 20. Bekerja sama dengan penasihat atau konsultan pajak dalam menyusun strategi tax planning yang optimal. Memeriksa dan memastikan pemotongan pajak vendor dilakukan menggunakan tarif yang tepat dan sesuai dengan peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku. 3. Systems Optimization, Budgeting & Cost Control Mengawasi dan memaksimalkan penggunaan ERP, khususnya Odoo , serta software perpajakan seperti Coretax, untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan efisiensi proses. Memantau cash flow serta budget divisi dan perusahaan. Menjalankan cost management dan mengidentifikasi peluang efisiensi maupun cost saving. Menyusun financial analysis yang membantu manajemen memahami kondisi bisnis dan mengambil keputusan. How You Work Anda memiliki rasa tanggung jawab dan ownership yang tinggi terhadap pekerjaan. Anda teliti dan memahami bahwa detail kecil dalam proses keuangan dapat berdampak pada akurasi laporan dan kepatuhan perusahaan. Anda terbiasa bekerja dengan deadline yang ketat tanpa mengorbankan kualitas. Anda mampu menganalisis data, menemukan discrepancy, serta memastikan masalah ditindaklanjuti hingga selesai. Anda proaktif mencari cara untuk meningkatkan proses, sistem, dan financial control. Anda mampu berkomunikasi dengan jelas dan bekerja sama dengan internal team, management, auditor, maupun konsultan pajak. What You’ll Enjoy as Our Team Incentives (monthly & quarterly) Tenure rewards & annual reviews Recognition & appreciation culture Well-being perks Your ideas matter and are rewarded

Mendukung proses cascading KPI dengan memastikan keterkaitan indikator, target, formula, sumber data, periode evaluasi, dan penanggung jawab. Performance Data Collection & Validation Mengumpulkan data realisasi KPI dari unit kerja sesuai periode monitoring yang ditetapkan. Memeriksa kelengkapan, konsistensi, dan kesesuaian data terhadap formula serta sumber data KPI. Melakukan klarifikasi kepada unit terkait apabila terdapat ketidaksesuaian, kekurangan, atau anomali data kinerja Performance Monitoring & Analysis Memantau realisasi KPI korporasi dan unit kerja secara berkala terhadap target yang telah ditetapkan. Mengolah dan menganalisis data untuk mengidentifikasi gap, tren pencapaian, serta potensi risiko ketidaktercapaian target. Menyiapkan analisis awal atas penyebab deviasi sebagai bahan evaluasi Kepala Departemen. Performance Reporting & Dashboard Menyusun laporan kinerja periodik yang memuat realisasi, target, status pencapaian, dan isu utama kinerja. Menyiapkan dan memperbarui dashboard kinerja yang mengintegrasikan indikator finansial dan nonfinansial. Menyiapkan bahan paparan dan data pendukung untuk management review, Direksi, maupun kebutuhan pelaporan lainnya. Corrective Action Monitoring Mengadministrasikan rencana tindakan korektif atas KPI atau program kerja yang mengalami deviasi. Memantau progres dan status tindak lanjut perbaikan dari unit kerja terkait. Mengidentifikasi corrective action yang belum efektif atau mengalami keterlambatan untuk dilaporkan kepada Kepala Departemen. Performance Governance & Documentation Melaksanakan proses pengelolaan kinerja sesuai kebijakan, prosedur, kalender, dan mekanisme yang ditetapkan. Memastikan bukti pendukung, histori perubahan, dan dokumentasi data kinerja tersimpan secara lengkap serta dapat ditelusuri. Mendukung pemanfaatan sistem digital dan tools performance management untuk meningkatkan akurasi serta efisiensi monitoring. Pengelolaan data dan pelaporan a. Mengumpulkan, memeriksa, mengolah, dan memelihara data serta dokumen pekerjaan

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Mempelajari dokumen Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation to Tender (ITT), spesifikasi teknis, gambar desain teknik, serta dokumen Scope of Work (SOW) dari pemilik proyek (misalnya KKKS atau perusahaan minyak multinasional). Menghitung secara detail volume material khusus migas (seperti pipa khusus, katup/valves, struktur platform, instrumen skid ) serta kebutuhan tenaga kerja ahli ( welder bersertifikat, piping engineer , dll). Menentukan standar harga untuk setiap satuan pekerjaan berdasarkan kompleksitas medan (misalnya proyek onshore vs offshore ). Menghubungi vendor dan sub-kontraktor untuk mendapatkan penawaran harga material, sewa alat berat (seperti crane barge , mesin drilling ), atau jasa penunjang migas. Mengevaluasi penawaran vendor untuk memastikan spesifikasi material telah memenuhi standar keselamatan migas internasional (seperti ASME, API, atau ASTM) dengan harga terbaik. Proyek oil & gas sangat sensitif terhadap perubahan cuaca, fluktuasi harga komoditas, dan regulasi ketat. Estimator harus cermat memasukkan biaya risiko dan dana darurat agar proyek tidak rugi di tengah jalan. Menganalisis jenis kontrak yang ditawarkan (misalnya Lump Sum , Unit Price , atau Cost-Plus ) guna memetakan potensi risiko komersial bagi perusahaan. Menggabungkan seluruh komponen biaya (material, jasa, overhead , keuntungan, dan pajak) ke dalam dokumen penawaran harga akhir untuk diajukan ke klien. Berkoordinasi dengan tim manajemen proyek ( Project Manager ) untuk memantau pengeluaran aktual di lapangan dan membandingkannya dengan estimasi awal demi menghindari pembengkakan biaya ( cost overrun )

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Melakukan pengecekan rutin ( safety patrol ) di area kerja berisiko tinggi seperti kilang, anjungan lepas pantai ( offshore ), atau area pengeboran ( drilling ). Memeriksa dan mengesahkan izin kerja berbahaya (seperti kerja panas/ hot work , kerja di ketinggian, atau di ruang terbatas). Memimpin pengarahan singkat setiap pagi atau sebelum shift kerja dimulai untuk mengingatkan potensi bahaya. Mengawasi kepatuhan pihak ketiga atau vendor terhadap aturan K3LH ( Kesehatan, Keselamatan Kerja, dan Lingkungan Hidup ). Menyelidiki akar penyebab kecelakaan atau near-miss (hampir celaka) dan membuat laporan serta rekomendasi pencegahan. Menjaga standar perusahaan sesuai aturan pemerintah Indonesia dan standar internasional seperti ISO 45001 (K3) dan ISO 14001

Connect the CEO with cross-functional teams to facilitate communication, alignment, and follow-through, representing leadership priorities when required.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Membuat dan meninjau dokumen teknik seperti Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID). Menentukan spesifikasi teknis untuk alat ukur ( instruments ), katup kendali ( control valves ), dan sistem keamanan ( ESD/Emergency Shutdown, DCS/Distributed Control System, F&G/Fire & Gas ). Membuat lembar data instrumen ( instrument data sheets ), diagram loop , dan daftar kebutuhan material ( Bill of Quantity / BoQ ). Menyiapkan dokumen permintaan penawaran ( request for quotation ) untuk vendor. Melakukan evaluasi teknis terhadap penawaran dari vendor atau penyuplai alat. Berkoordinasi dengan bagian pengadaan untuk memastikan peralatan sesuai dengan standar industri migas (seperti API, IEC, atau ISA). Memastikan parameter penting seperti suhu ( temperature ), tekanan ( pressure ), tingkat cairan ( level ), dan aliran ( flow ) terpantau secara akurat oleh sistem kontrol. Mengatasi masalah ( troubleshooting ) pada perangkat instrumen atau sistem kendali yang mengalami kerusakan untuk mencegah downtime atau shutdown pabrik. Mengatur jadwal dan prosedur kalibrasi alat ukur agar tetap presisi dan memenuhi standar keselamatan kerja. Memastikan sistem pengaman darurat berfungsi dengan baik guna mencegah kecelakaan kerja atau ledakan (seperti Pressure Safety Valves / PSV). Bekerja sama dengan disiplin ilmu lain seperti insinyur proses ( process engineer ), mekanik, dan kelistrikan ( electrical )

deskripsi_pekerjaan: As a Multimedia Designer at Odoo Indonesia, you will produce high-quality videos, graphics, motion, animation and other visual content that align with our brand . You will be involved in the full creative process from ideation and conceptualization to production and delivery—creating content that enhances our product marketing efforts across various channels. Additionally, you will collaborate with different departments and contribute to other creative projects, such as photo retouching and graphic design, helping to bring Odoo's visual identity to life. Your main focus will be on video production and editing, but you will also have the chance to work on multimedia design projects to create a broad range of digital content . Your tasks include but are not limited to: Lead the post-production process for product-focused video content, including video editing, motion graphics, visual effects, color correction, sound editing, and final delivery across different formats and platforms. Create engaging motion graphics and visual elements that enhance storytelling, product demonstrations, and marketing communication while maintaining consistency with Odoo's brand identity. Manage and contribute to the overall video production cycle, from pre-production and studio setup to filming and post-production, with a stronger focus on editing and motion design. Work closely with the marketing team and other departments to plan and execute video projects, ensuring the creative direction, visual execution, and final output align with Odoo's branding and messaging. Develop a deep understanding of Odoo's products to translate complex product features and benefits into clear, engaging, and visually compelling video content. Provide creative input and proactively suggest improvements to storytelling, editing, motion design, pacing, and overall video quality. Support onsite customer testimonial filming, studio shoots, and live streaming for webinars and other events, contributing to the production process as needed. Additional Multimedia Design Tasks: Maintain an organized archive of all video footage for future edits and reuse. Stay updated on the latest trends in video production and editing to bring fresh ideas and techniques into your work. Perform in-house photo retouching for presentations, events, and marketing materials. Workload Breakdown: Video & Motion Graphics: 60% of your workload will focus on video editing, motion graphics, post-production, and creating engaging visual content for product marketing, customer testimonials, webinars, and other marketing initiatives. Filming & Production: 30% of your workload will involve supporting and participating in the video production process, including studio setup, filming, lighting, basic production coordination, customer testimonials, webinars, and other onsite shoots. Traditional Graphic Design: 10% of your workload will involve creating static visual assets, photo retouching, and supporting other graphic design needs across marketing initiatives.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. About this Position We are looking for a Dry Inventory Senior Supervisor who will be responsible for leading daily dry warehouse operations, ensuring inventory accuracy and flow, optimizing manpower productivity, and maintaining high standards of operational quality, safety, and service level. Job Description As our Astronaut, your missions are: Lead and supervise daily warehouse operations, ensuring inventory activities are executed accurately and efficiently. Oversee inbound, picking, packing, inventory, and outbound activities to ensure operational targets are achieved. Monitor inventory accuracy, picking accuracy, packing correctness, storage order, and loading readiness. Ensure smooth inventory flow and proactively resolve operational issues such as mispicks, missing items, and other inventory discrepancies. Evaluate operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve manpower productivity, inventory accuracy, and service level. Manage shift scheduling, manpower allocation, attendance, shift rotation, and backup planning to ensure sufficient manpower coverage. Delegate tasks and monitor team performance to ensure execution meets quality and productivity targets. Conduct daily operational reporting aligned with key KPIs, including output, errors, incidents, and attendance. Collaborate with Supply Chain and Category teams to resolve operational issues and support inventory forecasting. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across inventory flow and accuracy. Ensure compliance with SOP, health, hygiene, safety, security, and 5S standards. Maintain operational discipline and ensure the team consistently follows established warehouse procedures.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Underwriters are responsible for calculating, analyzing, and assessing risks . They arrange insurance coverage, propose insurance terms and conditions, provide risk recommendations, and negotiate reinsurance placements. Participants will undergo comprehensive training with focuses on developing participants into underwriting specialists through an expert track aligned with Asuransi Astra’s business needs. Property & Casualty: Assess and underwrite risks for property, industrial assets, and general liability insurance. Energy, Engineering & Major Risks: Handle complex risks associated with energy, construction, infrastructure, and large-scale industrial projects. Heavy Equipment & Miscellaneous: Heavy equipment, machinery, and various specialized commercial risks. Health: Evaluate and manage underwriting risks for corporate and individual health insurance products. Retail Product Management: Develop, manage, and optimize retail insurance products to meet market needs and business objectives.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Position Overview Howel is looking for  Full-Time Merchandiser Staff to manage the flow of our products end to end, from purchase orders and supplier deliveries to stock, marketplace listings, and product development. This role goes beyond data entry. We are looking for someone who keeps product data accurate, follows up on every open item, and notices when quantities, prices, or stock do not add up before they become a problem. You will work closely with the Merchandising team and with other team to keep products available, correctly listed, and ready for launch on time. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys structured, recurring work with clear ownership and wants to understand how a consumer brand manages its products from supplier to customer. What Will You Do Purchase Orders & Deliveries Process and verify purchase orders (PO) and delivery orders (DO): create and send POs to suppliers, input incoming DOs, and check received quantities against delivery notes, coordinating with suppliers on any discrepancies. Follow up on supplier deliveries and shipment schedules, and monitor back orders (BO), outstanding POs, payments, and tax invoice updates in coordination with Finance. Stock & Marketplace Monitor stock levels in the system to flag low-stock, non-moving, or inactive products and errors in master product data, and take corrective action. Manage marketplace listings through the omnichannel platform (active/inactive status, photos, descriptions, quantities, categories) and maintain the weekly catalog, price updates, clearance, and bundle promotions. Product Development & Launches Support product development: keep the Trello board updated, follow up and review samples, provide feedback to suppliers, and join weekly Merchandising x Design meetings. Coordinate product launches: prepare launch briefs, request product descriptions and photos from the Content team, follow up designs with Creative, and ensure hangtags, accessories, and packaging are ready on time. Returns & Reporting Manage monthly returns: recap return data, coordinate with Ops and suppliers, and process return shipments and return POs. Prepare weekly meeting materials (PPT, repeat-order plan, returns recap, development updates, clearance proposals) and follow through on action items. Coordination & Periodic Reviews Handle daily coordination via internal and supplier group chats, and resolve cases raised by Finance, Ops, CS, and DC. Conduct periodic checks and reviews (showroom products, sample rack clearance, Google Drive files) and take part in seasonal development (Christmas, Ramadan), catalog and packaging reviews, and product quality tests such as towel tests.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and backed by trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people’s lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About the Role As an Inventory Operations Associate, you’ll support the team in keeping inventory healthy and operations running smoothly. You’ll work with data to monitor stock movement, spot issues, and help the team find practical solutions. Key Responsibilities As our Astronaut, your missions are: Monitor inbound, capacity, and outbound performance and highlight any gaps. Track inventory health, including DOI, bad stock, and stock movement. Help analyze inventory issues and support initiatives to reduce bad stock. Support capacity planning and inventory rebalancing across hubs. Follow up on pending SO/PO and other inventory movements. Support day-to-day inventory processes such as RTV, write-off, internal consumption, and backhaul. Help with ad-hoc analysis and operational requests when needed. Work closely with Supply Chain, Warehouse, and Hub teams to solve inventory-related issues.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. About this Position We're looking for a Quality Audit Officer,, you'll be on the ground ensuring ASTRO Hub Kitchens consistently meet our food quality, safety, and Halal standards. You'll investigate quality issues, uncover root causes, and work closely with Operations to turn audit findings into practical improvements through CAPA. Responsibilities As our Astronaut, your missions are: Conduct quality audits across ASTRO Hub Kitchens to ensure compliance with internal SOPs, food safety, food quality, and Halal standards. Perform basic quality checks, including pH, Brix, TDS, organoleptic assessment, visual inspection, and temperature monitoring. Identify and evaluate audit findings, then communicate issues and practical recommendations to Operations teams. Investigate customer complaints, product defects, rejects, and process deviations to identify root causes. Develop and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), including action plans, follow-ups, and closure status. Prepare accurate and objective audit reports and maintain proper documentation for each site visit. Conduct regular Hub visits and Mystery Shopper activities while maintaining confidentiality, objectivity, and integrity.

nama_pekerjaan: Book Advisor Prose and Petals Jakarta Utara
deskripsi_pekerjaan: Sebagai Book Advisor (Storekeeper & Cashier) , kamu akan berperan dalam menciptakan pengalaman belanja yang hangat dan menyenangkan bagi pelanggan dengan membantu mereka menemukan buku yang tepat serta memberikan rekomendasi yang mendalam dan personal. Posisi ini menuntut pengetahuan yang kuat tentang buku, genre, tren literasi, serta ketertarikan yang tinggi terhadap dunia buku, karena Book Advisor tidak hanya melayani pelanggan, tetapi juga membangun engagement dengan produk secara autentik dan penuh passion. Tugas utama mencakup pengelolaan transaksi penjualan, memastikan ketersediaan stok, serta mendukung berbagai program dan kampanye toko. Peran ini juga membutuhkan keterampilan komunikasi yang baik untuk membangun hubungan dengan pelanggan, menyampaikan informasi buku secara menarik, dan meningkatkan loyalitas pelanggan. Selain itu, Anda akan bekerja sama dengan tim dalam mengelola operasional harian toko, menyiapkan kebutuhan acara, serta memastikan proses pembelian berjalan lancar sesuai prosedur, dari tampilan buku hingga transaksi di kasir. Key Responsibilities: Sales and Customer Advisory Melayani pelanggan dengan ramah dan menciptakan pengalaman belanja yang hangat. Memberikan rekomendasi buku yang mendalam berdasarkan preferensi pelanggan untuk membangun loyalitas. Menggunakan keterampilan komunikasi yang menarik untuk menyampaikan informasi buku dan meningkatkan interaksi pelanggan. Product and Inventory Management Menguasai koleksi buku yang tersedia dan memahami tren literasi terkini untuk memberikan insight berharga kepada pelanggan. Memastikan ketersediaan stok buku dan melaporkan kebutuhan restock agar pelanggan selalu mendapatkan produk yang mereka cari. Berjejaring dengan tim dan manajemen untuk menyusun strategi display buku yang menarik dan sesuai dengan promosi. Store Operations Mengelola transaksi penjualan dan memastikan pembayaran berjalan lancar sesuai SOP. Memastikan pembelian pelanggan dilakukan dengan tertib dan efisien, dari display hingga kasir. Menyusun laporan harian terkait kinerja tim dan pengalaman pelanggan untuk evaluasi layanan. Mengidentifikasi serta menyelesaikan kendala operasional toko dengan pendekatan yang solutif dan efisien. Store Programmes and Collaboration with Team to Reach Success Berkomunikasi dengan tim untuk mengumpulkan feedback dan ide perbaikan layanan. Mendukung pelaksanaan program atau kampanye toko untuk meningkatkan engagement pelanggan dan daya tarik toko. Menyesuaikan strategi promosi dan event toko berdasarkan tren dan kebutuhan pelanggan.

Membina hubungan baik dengan dealer untuk meningkatkan pencapaian sales target. Memonitor produktivitas, kualitas proses dan hasil proses sales untuk mencapai target performance yang ditetapkan. Memberikan pelayanan kepada pelanggan dan/atau rekan kerja sesuai dengan standar service perusahaan sebagai bagian dari pekerjaan untuk mendukung terciptanya budaya service perusahaan.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Membuat simulasi kredit dan melakukan negosiasi, baik dengan dealer maupun calon pelanggan, untuk mendapatkan aplikasi pembiayaan pelanggan. Melengkapi data aplikasi pembiayaan dan dokumen pendukungnya, termasuk melakukan konfirmasi melalui telepon, proses data entry, inisiasi, dan scan dokumen ke docushare untuk menunjang proses analisa kredit yang cepat dan akurat. Menginformasikan hasil keputusan kredit kepada pihak-pihak terkait untuk memastikan informasi keputusan kredit diterima secara benar. Menindaklanjuti dokumen kelengkapan kendaraan dan dokumen tagihan dari dealer untuk memastikan kelancaran proses pembayaran kendaraan ke dealer (disburse). Memonitor pembiayaan selama 5 angsuran pertama dan bekerjasama dengan fungsi AR management dalam menyelesaikan account F5PD untuk memastikan agar pelanggan yang telah jatuh tempo memenuhi kewajibannya. Menjalankan aktivitas penunjang penjualan (mendukung pameran, show room event, dll) untuk meningkatkan pencapaian sales target. Membina hubungan baik dengan dealer untuk meningkatkan pencapaian sales target. Memonitor produktivitas, kualitas proses dan hasil proses sales untuk mencapai target performance yang ditetapkan. Memberikan pelayanan kepada pelanggan dan/atau rekan kerja sesuai dengan standar service perusahaan sebagai bagian dari pekerjaan untuk mendukung terciptanya budaya service perusahaan.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and backed by trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people’s lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this role As the Head of Customer Experience, you’ll own the strategy and transformation of Astro’s end-to-end experience across Customers, Operations, and Mitra. Your mission is to build a scalable, data-driven, and technology-enabled CX function that can keep pace with Astro’s growth including automating high-volume inquiries, improving complaint resolution, and turning customer and operational insights into meaningful improvements. Strategic Responsibilities As our Astronaut, your missions are: Own CX Strategy & Roadmap: Define CX strategy, OKRs, standards, organization structure, and roadmap across Customer, Hub, and Mitra experience. Build Scalable CX Operations: Develop inquiry and complaint segmentation based on customer type, case type, and severity to support high-volume operations. Lead CX Automation & AI: Drive automation of routine inquiries and develop AI-enabled solutions while ensuring human touch for complex complaints. Expand Customer & Mitra Experience: Build integrated complaint/inquiry management across Customer, Hub Operations, and Mitra, including satisfaction measurement. Drive Root-Cause Improvements: Partner with Operations, Quality, Commercial, and Product to eliminate recurring customer and operational issues. Own CX Performance & Financials: Drive CSAT/MSAT, productivity, service quality, and CX financial performance. Lead CX Organization: Build the team, capabilities, operating model, and performance culture to support business growth.

Menindaklanjuti dokumen kelengkapan kendaraan dan dokumen tagihan dari dealer untuk memastikan kelancaran proses pembayaran kendaraan ke dealer (disburse). Memberikan pelayanan kepada pelanggan dan/atau rekan kerja sesuai dengan standar service perusahaan sebagai bagian dari pekerjaan untuk mendukung terciptanya budaya service perusahaan.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About the Role The Growth & Marketing Manager will drive WAHU’s growth across customer acquisition, marketing, retention, product, and market expansion. You will work closely with HQ, city operations, product & tech teams, and external partners to turn customer insights and business opportunities into measurable initiatives. This is a hands-on and entrepreneurial role — you will identify opportunities, build the strategy, execute projects, track results, and improve what works. Key Responsibilities 1. Growth, Acquisition & Retention Develop and execute strategies to grow WAHU’s collector base. Own customer acquisition and performance marketing. Optimise the customer journey from acquisition to conversion and retention. Develop referral programmes, promotions, and growth campaigns. Drive collector engagement, retention, and reactivation. Track key growth metrics such as acquisition, conversion, and retention. Use AppsFlyer and campaign data to identify opportunities and improve performance. 2. Brand Marketing & Communication Develop and execute WAHU’s overall marketing and communication strategy. Grow WAHU’s reach through social media, content, digital marketing, KOL/influencers, and paid advertising. Manage online channels including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, website, and app stores. Plan and execute offline marketing activities, including hub launches, community programmes, neighbourhood activations, and retail/partner activations. Ensure consistent brand positioning, tone of voice, and communication across channels and languages. Develop CRM campaigns through push notifications, in-app messaging, and WhatsApp. Manage external marketing partners and agencies. 3. Product & App Development Act as the business-side partner for WAHU’s app development and optimisation. Identify product improvements based on collector feedback, data, and operational needs. Translate business and customer needs into clear product requirements. Help prioritise product improvements and new features. Support app releases, updates, and communication of new functionality. 4. Team, Agencies & Budget Lead the Social Media Manager and manage external online marketing and design agencies. Set clear briefs, targets, budgets, and performance expectations for agencies. Monitor quality and results and make improvements where needed. Build the marketing team gradually as business volume and needs grow. deskripsi_pekerjaan: About The Roles Make sure that every kilo a collector brings in is received, weighed, paid, and delivered onward — reliably, cheaply, and with data that holds up under audit. The Manager of Operations owns Wahu's physical capacity: how many collection points exist, whether they work, and how material moves from hub to MRF. Growth creates the demand; this role makes sure the network can absorb it. Job Descriptions Network build — hubs & dropboxes Owns the rollout plan against the 400–500 collection point target: site selection, partner onboarding, permits, installation, and launch readiness. Builds a repeatable installation process so opening a hub is a standard procedure, not a project. Manages the pipeline per partner and per region, phased against transport and MRF processing capacity  no hub opens that cannot be serviced. Proposes relocation or closure of underperforming points on cost and uptime evidence, with Growth consulted on whether demand can still be built. Delivers a hub that is ready to receive collectors on the agreed launch date, so Growth's pre-launch campaign lands on a working site. Hub operations — uptime and the collector experience on site Analyze and optimized hub for improvement Owns hub uptime: equipment working, scales calibrated, bins emptied, site clean and safe. Staffs and trains hub attendants; sets the service standard a collector meets at the counter. Owns payout execution  accurate weighing, correct rates (e.g. Rp 10,000/kg for aluminium cans), and payment into the app wallet without disputes. Runs preventive maintenance and a fast-response repair loop; a broken hub is a lost hub. Resolves partner-side issues at store level: space, access, signage, store staff cooperation. Logistics & collection Owns routing, collection frequency, fleet, and third-party transport so no hub overflows and no truck runs half empty. Plans capacity ahead of the rollout and ahead of campaign peaks flagged by Growth. Manages transport cost per kilo as a primary lever on unit economics. Owns chain-of-custody from hub to MRF — every load traceable to a source. Alignment with the MRF Coordinates with the MRF on delivery windows, intake planning, and volume forecasts. This is alignment between two organisations, not line management. Holds material quality at the handover: sorted, dry, and within agreed contamination limits  so volume is not lost at the gate. Gives the MRF a reliable forward forecast so processing capacity is planned ahead of the rollout, not after it. Flags early when network volume is about to outgrow available processing capacity. Resolves handover disputes on weight, quality, and documentation. Cost, data & compliance Owns all-in operational cost per kilo, hub to MRF  collection, transport, handling, payout  and drives it down as volume scales. Owns the operational data layer feeding the dashboard: volumes, weights, uptime, routes, deliveries. One source of truth, shared with Growth and Finance. Guards traceability so volume claims survive audit by partners, certifiers, and plastic-credit markets (PPRS, PCX Markets). Owns permits, KLHK and other regulatory reporting, and QHSE across all sites. Owns safety: this is a business with vehicles, machinery, and manual handling.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About this Position This role focuses on building and optimizing high-performance Android applications that deliver smooth, responsive, and seamless user experiences. You will collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to develop new features, improve application performance, and deliver fluid UI transitions and animations comparable to leading quick-commerce applications such as Blinkit and Zepto. You will also take ownership of performance profiling, troubleshooting, and optimization across app startup time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. Additionally, you will explore and leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows. As our Astronaut, your missions are: Lead the development, optimization, and maintenance of Android applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, and code quality. Identify, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks related to app startup time, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. Implement smooth UI transitions, animations, gestures, and micro-interactions to deliver a responsive and seamless user experience comparable to Blinkit and Zepto. Profile and optimize Android rendering performance, scrolling behavior, frame rendering time, and main-thread execution to minimize UI jank and frozen frames. Collaborate with Product and Design teams to translate UI/UX requirements into polished, high-performance Android experiences. Establish performance benchmarks, monitor production metrics, and continuously improve application responsiveness and resource efficiency. Lead technical design discussions, break down complex engineering problems into actionable tasks, and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery. Perform code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices in Android development, performance optimization, testing, and maintainable architecture. Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement. Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows, including coding, debugging, refactoring, test generation, and documentation. Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and performance before integrating them into production applications.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this Position We're looking for a Product Designer with a strong visual design taste, sharp product thinking, and a passion for crafting delightful user experiences. If you enjoy leveraging AI to accelerate your creative process, we'd love to meet you. Responsibilities As our Astronaut, your missions are: Own the end-to-end product design process, from discovery to final implementation. Conduct user research, field observations, and usability testing to uncover user needs. Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces for web and mobile products. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle. Continuously iterate designs based on user feedback, research findings, and product metrics. Maintain consistency by contributing to and utilizing design systems and UI guidelines. Prepare design assets and ensure smooth handoff to the engineering team. Leverage AI tools to accelerate design exploration, ideation, and productivity. Stay updated with emerging design trends, technologies, and best practices.

nama_pekerjaan: Zero Waste Initiative Anaerobic Digester & Composting Officer at PT Kawasan Industri Terpadu Batang member of PT Danareksa Persero
deskripsi_pekerjaan: Operasional Anaerobic Digester Mengoperasikan fasilitas anaerobic digester sesuai SOP dan parameter proses yang ditetapkan. Memastikan material organik yang masuk sesuai kebutuhan dan kapasitas proses. Menjaga stabilitas operasional digester agar pengolahan limbah organik berjalan optimal. Operasional Composting Melaksanakan proses composting limbah organik sesuai metode dan tahapan kerja yang ditetapkan. Mengatur komposisi bahan, kelembapan, suhu, dan kondisi tumpukan/reaktor kompos. Memastikan proses berjalan hingga menghasilkan kompos sesuai spesifikasi internal. Monitoring Parameter Proses Biologis Memantau parameter proses biologis seperti suhu, pH, kelembapan, loading rate, dan stabilitas proses. Mencatat hasil monitoring secara berkala. Menindaklanjuti deviasi parameter dengan tindakan korektif awal. Pengelolaan Hasil Olahan Mengelola output hasil proses seperti kompos, biogas, residu, atau produk turunan lainnya. Memastikan hasil olahan tertangani sesuai prosedur dan tujuan pemanfaatannya. Mencatat volume dan kualitas hasil pengolahan untuk evaluasi program. Optimalisasi Program Zero Waste Mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan efisiensi proses anaerobic digester dan composting. Mengusulkan perbaikan metode kerja, pemanfaatan hasil olahan, atau peningkatan proses. Mendukung pelaksanaan inisiatif pengurangan limbah dan circular economy di kawasan. Pelaporan Program Zero Waste Mengisi logsheet operasional fasilitas anaerobic digester dan composting. Menyusun laporan volume limbah organik terolah dan hasil pemrosesan. Menyampaikan data program zero waste sebagai dasar monitoring dan evaluasi atasan. Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko.

Design, build, release, and operate customer-facing AI capabilities across product discovery, supported cart and payment journeys, platform assistance, and post-purchase support, in partnership with the relevant service owners. Discover and validate problems. Understand customer journeys through feedback, usage data, and execution traces; embed with business users to observe workflows and investigate bottlenecks, errors, repetitive tasks, and knowledge gaps. Define value before building. Establish baselines, identify accountable stakeholders, prioritize opportunities, and agree on success measures, acceptance criteria, and experiment stop conditions. Choose practical solutions. Compare process changes, existing tools, system integrations, custom software, data solutions, and AI against expected value, delivery effort, operating cost, and risk. Iterate through small releases and direct user feedback. Apply AI to real workflows. Validate conversation context, factual grounding, and the correctness of actions across retries and partial failures. Drive adoption and improve experience. Work with Product and Design on customer usability and task completion. For internal workflows, co-design with users, demonstrate progress, train users, and address adoption barriers. Own production operation. Coordinate releases, monitor reliability, latency, AI quality, and cost, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve AIRO and assigned solutions. Establish ongoing ownership explicitly and transfer support only through an accepted handover. Prove business impact. Compare results with the agreed baseline and recommend whether to scale, improve, transfer, or stop an initiative. Make learning reusable. Document decisions, runbooks, integrations, and delivery patterns; share platform needs and reusable improvements with the relevant engineering owners.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Role Overview Mendukung pelaksanaan program Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) melalui pengelolaan administrasi program, koordinasi operasional, dokumentasi kegiatan, serta penyusunan materi komunikasi dan publikasi. Posisi ini berperan dalam memastikan seluruh aktivitas CSR terdokumentasi dengan baik, berjalan sesuai rencana, dan mendukung peningkatan citra perusahaan melalui konten visual maupun laporan kegiatan. Tanggung Jawab Mendukung proses administrasi program CSR, termasuk penyusunan dokumen, monitoring timeline, pengarsipan, serta tindak lanjut (follow up) terhadap kebutuhan program. Membantu proses pelaksanaan kegiatan CSR mulai dari tahap persiapan, pelaksanaan, hingga penyusunan laporan pasca kegiatan. Mengumpulkan, mengelola, dan menyusun data serta dokumentasi kegiatan CSR sebagai bahan pelaporan internal maupun eksternal. Membuat materi desain grafis sesuai kebutuhan program CSR, seperti e-flyer, poster, banner, media sosial, infografis, dan materi komunikasi lainnya dengan mengikuti standar identitas perusahaan. Melakukan proses dokumentasi kegiatan berupa pengambilan foto dan video serta melakukan editing untuk menghasilkan konten visual yang informatif dan berkualitas. deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this Position This role is responsible for ensuring product quality across web and mobile applications by designing and executing thorough manual testing throughout the development lifecycle. The Quality Engineer will review product requirements, create test cases, identify and document defects, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to validate expected system behavior before release. The role also involves API testing, maintaining test documentation, and leveraging tools or AI to improve test planning and QA efficiency.. Responsibilities Review Product Requirement Documents (PRD) to understand business logic, product behavior, and technical requirements before testing begins. Design and create detailed, structured, and traceable test scenarios and test cases based on PRD and functional requirements. Perform manual testing across web, mobile, and API platforms to ensure product functionality, usability, and reliability meet quality standards. Conduct API testing using Postman to validate request/response behavior, data integrity, and service integration. Identify, document, and track bugs or issues clearly through Jira , ensuring proper reproduction steps and impact analysis are captured. Work closely with engineers and product managers to reproduce issues, clarify requirements, and validate expected system behavior. Manage and maintain test cases using TestRail , ensuring test coverage remains accurate and up to date throughout development cycles. Document testing results, findings, and release readiness reports in Confluence to maintain transparency and traceability across teams. Support release validation through regression testing to ensure new changes do not negatively impact existing functionality. Utilize AI tools to assist QA activities, such as breaking down PRDs, generating test scenarios, and improving test planning efficiency. Demonstrate understanding of basic test automation concepts and collaborate with engineers when automation is involved (e.g., WebdriverIO for mobile testing and Playwright f or web testing).

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. About this Position We are looking for a Development Portfolio Manager who will be responsible for managing the end-to-end New SKU onboarding process, monitoring assortment performance, and driving process improvements to support assortment expansion and operational efficiency. Job Description As our Astronaut, your missions are: Manage the end-to-end New SKU process, from pipeline tracking and approval to onboarding and projection. Monitor and manage the New SKU pipeline across multiple commercial teams, ensuring SKU progress is aligned with agreed timelines and SLA. Review and approve New SKU submissions by ensuring the required information, registration, and certification are complete and ready for onboarding. Prepare New SKU projections by forecasting upcoming SKU volume to support assortment and inventory planning. Identify potential bottlenecks, delays, and process gaps in the New SKU journey and proactively follow up with relevant stakeholders. Monitor Search No Result (SNR) and other relevant indicators to identify product discoverability and assortment gaps. Translate data and performance findings into actionable recommendations for Commercial, Supply Chain, Campaign, and Merchandising teams. Track agreed action plans and follow up with stakeholders to ensure improvement initiatives are implemented and performance gaps are addressed. Collect, consolidate, and process data from multiple sources to support assortment planning and business decision-making. Maintain accurate trackers and reporting for New SKU pipeline, onboarding progress, projections, and performance monitoring. Collaborate with Data teams to improve reporting, automate repetitive processes, and enhance operational efficiency. Continuously identify opportunities to simplify and improve existing business processes and SLA. Prepare regular reporting and insights, including weekly New SKU performance reports and monthly SNR analysis, and highlight key findings, risks, and areas requiring attention.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About this Position As a Data Platform Engineer — External Data Acquisition , you will build and operate ASTRO's platform for acquiring data from external sources, including websites, web/mobile applications, APIs, public datasets, and third-party data providers. A significant part of this role focuses on production-grade web and application data acquisition for pricing and market intelligence use cases. You will own the acquisition layer—from understanding external systems and extracting data to delivering reliable landing data for downstream processing. Focus : External Data Acquisition · Web & App Scraping · Python · HTTP/API · Data Pipelines · Reliability As our Astronaut, your missions are: Build and maintain reliable web/app crawlers, scrapers, and external API integrations across e-commerce, marketplace, retail, and other external sources. Analyze browser, mobile application, API, and network traffic to understand how data is delivered and design the appropriate acquisition approach and runtime, from direct HTTP/API extraction to browser automation. Build acquisition systems that remain reliable as external websites, applications, APIs, and data contracts evolve. Handle real-world source complexity such as sessions, tokens, pagination, dynamic content, rate limits, retries, concurrency, and partial failures. Build resilient and maintainable acquisition systems with appropriate testing, idempotency, deduplication, retries, safe reruns, data-quality validation, monitoring, and alerting. Operate acquisition workloads using appropriate workflow orchestration, compute, data storage/warehousing, and cloud infrastructure. Continuously improve reliability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership, including evaluating build-vs-buy approaches for external data. Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development or automation to improve how external-data pipelines are built, operated, and maintained. Collaborate with Pricing, Data Warehouse Engineering, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to turn external-data needs into sustainable platform capabilities.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Are you interested in being a part of a Mission-Driven Fintech Company? We are a start-up BSP-licensed EMI and VASP company on a mission to revolutionize digital finance in the Philippines. Our vision is bold: to lead the way in providing secure, compliant, and transparent financial services powered by the latest in fintech innovation. We are not just building an e-wallet! We are crafting a next-generation digital payment ecosystem that is reliable, efficient, and inclusive for every Filipino! You will not only be part of introducing Cryptocurrencies to the common Filipino, but you will also be the bridge that connect millions of Filipinos to the benefits of Blockchain technology. As we scale our impact, we are on the hunt for like-minded individuals who share the same passion and interest. Risk Management Officer This role is open to eager individuals who have an interest in the world of finance and the blockchain. For this role, we are looking for people with experience handling risk-related issues or risk management practices. What’s important for us is a highly aware candidate towards risks that considers all possibilities in any aspect and would be able to relay this professionally. What are we looking for in a candidate? Attentive listener and effective communicator – You ask the right questions and absorb feedback fast. You have the ability to translate complex ideas into clear messages. Analytical Thinker – You ask "Why" and "What's next?" then connect the dots that others usually miss and turn data into defensible decisions. Problem Solver – You can break down problems with clarity and precision by looking at the bigger picture. You have the capability to make smart decisions based on facts and not based on gut feelings. Team Collaborator – You share ideas, listen well, and know when to lead and when to support because you value the time of others. Quick Adaptability – You stay updated and agile in the face of regulatory or operational changes. Excellent Reading Comprehension – You rapidly absorb training, regulatory updates and internal communications while keeping ahead of change. Any degree in Risk Management, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Mathematics, Social Sciences or a related field is a plus. With professional experience in a risk-related function within financial services, EMI/VASP, banking, insurance, or a highly regulated sector such as healthcare or telecommunications. Proven experience or willing to learn in conducting enterprise risk assessments, designing risk mitigation plans, and engaging with regulatory bodies. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with experience managing cross-functional teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex risk scenarios to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience in writing policies and procedures is valued, though not required. It is a plus to have knowledge or experience of AMLA, BSP Circulars, and FATF guidelines. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the Philippines without employer visa sponsorship.

We are building a secure, compliant, and transparent digital finance ecosystem that supports modern payment, wallet, and virtual asset services. You do not need to be a crypto expert. However, you must be willing to learn how finance, treasury, bookkeeping, compliance, and audit documentation work in an EMI/VASP environment. What You’ll Do Bookkeeping and Financial Records Record, organize, and maintain financial transactions and supporting documents. Assist in maintaining accurate books and financial records for management review. Support documentation for expenses, payables, receivables, bank transactions, and other finance-related activities. Ensure that financial records are complete, accurate, properly filed, and easy to verify. Report missing documents, unusual entries, discrepancies, or unclear transactions to management in a timely manner. Cash, Banking, and Treasury Support Assist in daily cash management processes, including bank transfers, withdrawals, deposits, and related documentation. Monitor and organize cash inflow and cash outflow records. Raise cash movement issues, unreconciled items, or documentation gaps in a timely manner. Assist in maintaining proper records of bank transactions and treasury activities. Ensure treasury-related documents are properly supported, reviewed, and filed. Accounts Payable, Receivable, and Expense Documentation Assist in checking, organizing, and recording supplier invoices, receipts, payment requests, reimbursements, and other expense documents. Help monitor payable and receivable-related records. Support proper filing of official receipts, invoices, billing statements, bank confirmations, and related financial documents. Audit Readiness and Internal Control Support Prepare and organize financial documents needed for internal audit, external audit, management review, and regulatory readiness. Assist with walkthroughs, document requests, and audit-related checking. Support the review of financial records, reconciliations, and supporting documents. Help identify documentation gaps, control weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement. Assist in follow-up activities related to audit observations, management actions, or required corrections. Support internal control activities without replacing the independent role of internal audit. Regulatory and Management Support Help ensure finance-related records are organized and ready for review. Assist in monitoring relevant circulars, memoranda, internal policies, and finance-related procedures. Support the preparation of reports, summaries, and financial schedules needed by management. Coordinate with finance, operations, compliance, and audit-related teams when needed. Perform other finance, bookkeeping, treasury, and documentation-related duties as required. Schedule Monday to Friday, Day Shift Benefits HMO upon regularization Paid holidays Paid vacation leave Transportation allowance Exposure to fintech, EMI, VASP, treasury, bookkeeping, accounting, and audit support operations Opportunity to grow in a BSP-regulated financial technology company

nama_pekerjaan: Internal Audit Associate  Fintech EMI VASP Operations
deskripsi_pekerjaan: Are you interested in being part of a mission-driven fintech company? WIBS PHP INC. is a BSP-licensed Electronic Money Issuer EMI and Virtual Asset Service Provider VASP company in the Philippines. We are building a secure, compliant, and transparent digital finance ecosystem that supports modern payment, wallet, and virtual asset services. As we continue to grow, we are looking for an Internal Audit Associate who can help evaluate internal controls, review operational processes, test compliance with company policies, identify control weaknesses, and support audit reporting and follow-up activities. This role is suitable for candidates who want to grow in internal audit, risk management, compliance review, internal control, governance, and audit documentation within a regulated fintech company. You do not need to be a crypto expert. However, you must be willing to learn how internal audit, compliance, finance, operations, and risk management work in an EMI/VASP environment. What You’ll Do Internal Audit and Control Testing Assist in planning, performing, and documenting internal audit procedures. Review business processes, internal controls, and operational procedures. Test whether departments follow approved policies, procedures, and control activities. Check the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of documents, records, and supporting evidence. Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, documentation issues, and potential risk areas. Assist in validating whether corrective actions were properly implemented. Risk, Governance, and Compliance Review Support reviews related to operational risk, financial controls, compliance processes, and governance procedures. Assist in checking whether company activities are aligned with internal policies and regulatory expectations. Review relevant circulars, memoranda, policies, and procedures connected to the company’s business processes. Help assess whether departments maintain proper records, approvals, reports, and supporting documents. Escalate unusual findings, repeated issues, or possible non-compliance to the appropriate supervisor or manager. Audit Documentation and Reporting Prepare audit working papers, checklists, summaries, and supporting documentation. Assist in preparing audit reports, including findings, risk impact, recommendations, and management responses. Maintain organized audit files for internal review, external audit, management review, and regulatory readiness. Track audit findings, action plans, target dates, and follow-up status. Process Improvement and Advisory Support Support departments in understanding audit findings and required corrective actions. Help improve audit templates, control checklists, documentation standards, and reporting formats. Assist in promoting accountability, transparency, and proper governance across the company. Coordination and Audit Readiness Assist with walkthroughs, document requests, and process clarification meetings. Support internal and external audit readiness by ensuring requested documents are complete and properly organized. Perform other internal audit, control review, risk assessment, and documentation-related duties as required. Work Environment Strictly On-Site at Ayala Avenue, Makati City Schedule Monday to Friday, Day Shift Benefits HMO upon regularization Paid holidays Paid vacation leave Transportation allowance Exposure to fintech, EMI, VASP, internal audit, risk management, compliance, and governance operations Opportunity to grow in a BSP-regulated financial technology company

deskripsi_pekerjaan: MedGrocer's digitally-enabled medicine programs, telehealth services, and corporate clinic medical staff work with hundreds of employers and pharma companies to improve the physical and mental health of over one million Filipinos every year. The Digital Health Specialist is a key member of the operations team, responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient delivery of our virtual care services. This role involves coordinating daily activities with healthcare professionals (HCPs), managing escalations, and balancing stakeholder needs. You will use data to identify service improvements and help manage projects to maintain a high-quality experience for our patients and partners. Why Join MedGrocer? At MedGrocer, you will have the autonomy to manage engaging projects, from optimizing HCP schedules to implementing operational improvements. Your work in coordinating our telehealth services directly contributes to our purpose of enhancing the health of patients through our digitally-enabled platform. You will achieve this while collaborating with a dynamic team and a wide network of medical experts. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily operations with healthcare professionals (HCPs), analyze scheduling demand, and create quarterly HCP schedules. Address and resolve escalations from various stakeholders, including HCPs, patients, and corporate accounts. Monitor key performance indicators, analyze data to identify process improvements, and prepare client reports. Drive the implementation of data-informed solutions and track the completion of project milestones. Support the training, development, and engagement of the HCP network. Perks and Benefits Performance Incentives & Career Progression : Recognition through clear pathways for advancement, promotion opportunities, and performance-based bonuses. Growth & Impact : A clear path for professional development and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on patient health. Cross-Functional Learning : Opportunities to collaborate across different teams, expanding your skill set and broadening your understanding of the business. Health & Wellness Coverage : HMO benefits to ensure your peace of mind, paired with free medical consultations and unlimited essential medicines. Paid Time Off : Paid leaves to rest, recharge, and attend to personal priorities. HR will notify you if your evaluation concludes early. Please arrive at the venue between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM. The detailed schedule is as follows: Initial Assessment 8:00 AM - 10:00 AM : Onsite Assessment Supplementary Assessment (as needed) 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM : HR Panel Interview 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM : Lunch Break 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM : One-on-One Interviews 4:00 PM - 5:30 PM : CEO Forum Step 3 : Final review and background checks occur within three business days. Serve as the primary medical authority for complex health escalations, providing decisive advice and solutions to ensure patient safety and well-being. Collaborate with clients' HR departments by analyzing employee health data to identify chronic disease trends and provide strategic recommendations that improve workforce health and productivity. Growth & Impact : A clear path for professional development and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on patient health. Cross-Functional Learning : Opportunities to collaborate across different teams, expanding your skill set and broadening your understanding of the business. Health & Wellness Coverage : HMO benefits to ensure your peace of mind, paired with free medical consultations and unlimited essential medicines. Paid Time Off : Paid leaves to rest, recharge, and attend to personal priorities. HR will notify you if your evaluation concludes early. Please arrive at the venue between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM.
