deskripsi_pekerjaan: The BTL & Activation Specialist supports the sourcing, costing, and execution of BTL activations, events, and other on-ground marketing activities. The role focuses on identifying, evaluating, and managing reliable suppliers, production partners, venues, manpower providers, fabricators, and other service providers needed for successful campaign execution. The position works closely with Account Management, Creative, Finance, and Operations to translate campaign requirements into practical and cost-effective solutions. Summary Supplier & Partner Management Source, evaluate, and manage reliable suppliers and production partners for BTL and on-ground activations. Build and maintain a supplier database and strong vendor relationships. Assess supplier capabilities, pricing, quality, reliability, and capacity. Monitor supplier performance and negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, and other commercial conditions. BTL & Activation Sourcing & Costing Source suppliers, venues, manpower, and production solutions based on campaign requirements and client briefs. Support sourcing for brand activations, roadshows, mall/retail activations, trade events, sampling, product launches, exhibitions/booths, pop-ups, experiential marketing, POSM, logistics, and production. Scout and recommend suitable suppliers, venues, fabricators, and manpower providers. Request, compare, and analyze supplier quotations and prepare cost estimates. Support proposal and budget development with Account Management and Operations. Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and campaign requirements. Provide cost comparisons, recommendations, and identify potential risks or hidden costs. Help monitor project costs against approved budgets. Activation & Production Execution Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams from pre-production to project completion. Ensure suppliers understand project requirements, timelines, quality standards, and deliverables. Coordinate production schedules, installations, dismantling, logistics, and other pre-production requirements. Support site visits, supplier meetings, and on-ground execution when needed. Help ensure campaign materials, equipment, and manpower are ready for execution. Procurement, Documentation & Compliance Follow company procurement, production, and financial policies and procedures. Manage supplier-related documentation, including quotations, canvass documents, POs, contracts, delivery documents, and other records. Maintain accurate and updated supplier and pricing databases. Coordinate with Finance on billing, invoices, payments, and supporting documents. Ensure documentation is complete and properly filed for audit and BIR requirements. Understand campaign objectives, requirements, and commercial considerations. Work closely with Account Management, Creative, Operations, and Finance to deliver project requirements. Provide recommendations on suppliers, production methods, materials, timelines, and costs. Support campaign planning, supplier briefings, production meetings, and post-project evaluations. Help develop supplier packages, production standards, and cost benchmarks. Ensure suppliers and production partners meet agreed commercial, quality, safety, and ethical standards. Maintain professional and transparent supplier relationships. Ensure fair and compliant supplier selection and negotiation processes. Escalate supplier performance issues, commercial concerns, or potential conflicts of interest. Ensure suppliers are properly documented and paid according to agreed terms and company processes

Cross Functional Assistance Perform other operationally required tasks assigned by heads. Adhere to company standards and policies at all times.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Signing Bonus Included! Do you enjoy teaching people, solving real problems, and helping others feel confident using new technology? Are you someone who can simplify complex ideas and make learning feel easy and approachable? As a Digital Training Associate, you’ll guide clients from onboarding to everyday success with UTAK POS. You’ll work closely with business owners and their teams, helping them understand the system, answering real questions, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way. Beyond training, you’ll also help improve how we onboard and support MSMEs as we continue to grow. Client Onboarding : You’ll help new clients get started smoothly by guiding them through setup and early product use. Training Delivery : You’ll conduct 1-on-1 and group training sessions that are clear, practical, and easy to follow. Product Education : You’ll explain key features, benefits, and real-world use cases so clients can confidently apply what they learn in their daily operations. Client Support : You’ll answer questions, help troubleshoot issues, and provide simple solutions that help clients navigate the system confidently. Make the Product Click : You’ll break down complex processes into easy-to-understand lessons for both tech-savvy and non-tech-savvy users. Client Engagement : You’ll regularly check in with clients to support ongoing learning and ensure they continue getting value from the product. Training Improvement : You’ll gather client feedback and help improve training materials, processes, and delivery methods over time. Cross-Team Collaboration : You’ll work closely with product, support, tech, and sales teams to stay aligned on updates and client needs. Organization & Tracking : You’ll maintain accurate training records, client progress notes, and feedback to keep operations organized and efficient. On-Ground Support : You may visit client stores or locations when needed to conduct in-person trainings and better understand their operations.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Elite Translations is looking for an experienced and results-driven Head of Sales to lead our sales team and drive the company’s revenue growth. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, managing key client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and building a high-performing sales organization. Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies aligned with the company’s business objectives and revenue targets. Lead, manage, and mentor the sales team to achieve individual and overall sales goals. Establish sales targets, KPIs, performance metrics, and action plans. Identify and pursue new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, partnerships, referrals, and other business development initiatives. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision-makers, and strategic accounts. Oversee the entire sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to proposal, negotiation, closing, and account management. Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and ensure consistent follow-through on opportunities. Prepare and present sales proposals, quotations, and business presentations to prospective and existing clients. Work closely with Operations, Project Management, and other departments to ensure client requirements are properly addressed and delivered. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify opportunities for business growth. Analyze sales performance and provide regular reports, forecasts, and recommendations to management. Develop strategies to improve client retention, account growth, and upselling/cross-selling opportunities. Establish and maintain sales processes, systems, and best practices to improve team productivity and efficiency. Represent Elite Translations in client meetings, business events, networking activities, and other relevant engagements. Perform other sales and business development responsibilities as needed.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Business Development and Partnerships Associate will support the company in building and operating a repeatable go-to-market system. This associate-level role is ideal for someone who is organized, proactive, research-oriented, commercially curious, and interested in learning business development, partnerships, sales operations, and technology solutions. Key Responsibilities Business Development Support Research target companies, industries, decision-makers, and potential client opportunities. Build and maintain target account lists based on priority customer segments. Support initial lead qualification by gathering information on business needs, company fit, decision-makers, timing, and potential opportunity value. Prepare pre-meeting briefs for discovery calls, partner meetings, and client conversations. Document meeting notes, client needs, objections, buying signals, next steps, and follow-up actions. Coordinate sales follow-through for active opportunities. CRM and Pipeline Management Support CRM hygiene and reporting discipline across GTM activities. Track leads, qualified opportunities, proposals, partner referrals, and follow-up schedules. Prepare weekly or monthly pipeline updates for internal review. Monitor stale opportunities and ensure follow-ups are not missed. Partnerships and Referral Program Support Build and maintain the company’s partner and referral tracker. Research potential referral partners, strategic partners, collaborators, subcontractors, marketing partners, and ecosystem partners. Coordinate follow-ups with potential partners and referral sources. Document partner fit, collaboration type, referral status, next steps, and potential opportunity areas. Assist in preparing materials that partners can use to understand and refer the company’s services. Track partner-sourced opportunities and ensure proper follow-through. Sales and Proposal Coordination Support coordination between Product and Delivery Management, Engineering, Finance, and other relevant teams during opportunity assessment Help ensure opportunities are reviewed for fit, delivery feasibility, commercial quality, and next-step readiness. Assist in preparing proposal inputs, client background research, and opportunity summaries. Track proposal status, client responses, pending requirements, and next actions. Ensure commercial opportunities are properly documented before moving forward. Market Feedback and Offering Validation Support Document market feedback from client conversations, partner discussions, and commercial validation activities. Capture customer pains, objections, buying signals, pricing feedback, and segment fit. Support validation efforts for company-owned or emerging offerings, including productized services, AI-enabled packages, and venture/incubation concepts. Prepare summaries of market learnings to support GTM, product, and leadership discussions. Marketing and GTM Coordination Support Coordinate with internal and external marketing partners, agencies, or freelancers when needed. Support preparation of GTM materials such as company profiles, service one-pagers, product overviews, case study inputs, and campaign lists. Help organize lead source tracking across referrals, partners, outbound activities, events, digital channels, and existing networks. Assist in monitoring GTM activity and lead source effectiveness.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About the Role The Customer Relations Officer is responsible for managing customer interactions across online marketplaces (e.g., Lazada, Shopee) and social media platforms (e.g., Facebook, Instagram), ensuring all queries, complaints, and feedback are responded to promptly, courteously, and efficiently. Support special projects, promotions, and company initiatives as assigned by supervisors.

Collaborates with internal teams to ensure client concerns are resolved efficiently and effectively Other Operational Duties Performs other tasks as assigned to support operational requirements, business objectives, and team initiatives. Participates in ad-hoc projects, training programs, and company initiatives as needed.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. About the Sales Team At our core, the Sales team is built to grow the company. We're focused on bringing in top-tier professionals who are prepared to offer an exceptional experience for our customers. We're a scaling sales organization on the lookout for dynamic leaders who are ready to build with us. The ideal candidate has strong sales expertise and understands that building trust and rapport with our pros is crucial for long-term relationships. In this pivotal role, you will directly influence the team's growth and company revenue by surfacing key insights from sales conversations, testing new data sources and processes, and improving the quality and quantity of pros on our platform. What you’ll do Team Leadership: Cultivate a high-morale, high-performance sales culture by setting and achieving ambitious team goals. Coaching & Development: Train and mentor all team members, from new hires to tenured staff, on sales strategies, scripting, and processes, particularly within a remote environment. Process Improvement: Manage dynamic sales campaigns, optimize team productivity, and streamline the workflow and operations for SDRs or AEs. Strategic Feedback: Provide direct feedback to Sales Leadership, Operations, and Enablement to improve workflow efficiency and identify key training opportunities. Product Expertise: Become an expert in the product and clearly articulate its value to every professional. Performance Management: Consistently monitor and document team performance.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Cast LMS (Buri Technologies Inc.) is an e-learning development startup that focuses on helping companies transition into e-learning using our content creation service and proprietary learning management system. We are looking for individuals who seek challenges and aspire to change the Philippine e-learning landscape by helping organizations build their training materials for the future and build software products that can help educators all over the country. We seek a Product Support and Quality Specialist who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and figuring out how things work to join our team. In this role, you will provide crucial support to both our operations and engineering team, ensuring efficient daily operations. We are a remote-first company, so you will work from home most of the time. From time to time, the team meets at our Quezon City office for activities such as Build Days, planning, or collaborative problem-solving. Some customer engagements may also require visiting a client's office, particularly for training, onboarding, or concerns that are better handled in person. Responsibilities: Assist the administrators who manage their organization's Cast LMS deployment by: Answering questions and help customers use Cast LMS. Understanding and resolving customer concerns whenever possible. Helping learners who contact us about access, courses, completion, and other issues, usually through email. Staying calm and helpful when a customer is frustrated or something is urgent. Asking the right questions and investigate the problem before escalating it. Keeping customers updated until their concern is resolved. Help customers become comfortable using Cast LMS by: Conducting training for administrators and learners, usually online but occasionally at a client's office. Creating and updating help articles and our online knowledge base. Creating or updating walkthroughs, videos, and other guides. Improving documentation when you notice questions or problems that come up repeatedly. Find problems before customers do by: Testing new and existing features. Checking important customer and learner workflows. Reproducing reported problems. Verifying that issues have been fixed. Reporting anything that does not work as expected. You will work with our Product and Engineering teams when deeper technical investigation is needed. We will teach you our testing process and the tools you need to use.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: We're looking for a new graduate who's been making videos and exploring AI image and video tools. Develop prompt engineering and tool fluency. Build expertise in prompting, model selection, and parameter tuning across image, video, and voice tools. Maintain a working library of prompts, references, and visual style guides. Learn and explore AI continuously. Track emerging AI models, techniques, and platforms. Run small experiments to test new tools, push toward more compelling outputs, and share findings with the team — your curiosity directly shapes our creative capabilities. Tools: You don't need to know all of these on day one — but you should know some, and want to learn the rest. deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Finance Manager oversees and consolidates financial operations, budget proposals, and procurement processes to ensure full alignment with city goals and project objectives. This role plays a critical part in project monitoring, inspection, post-procurement evaluation, and compliance with government budgeting and auditing rules. The ideal candidate possesses strong financial management capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and expertise in public sector procurement within a dynamic government setting. Key Responsibilities: 1. Budgeting and Procurement Planning: Prepares and consolidates Project Procurement Management Plans (PPMPs), budget proposals, and procurement requirements. Ensures that all procurement needs are strictly aligned with approved budgets, PPMPs, and project objectives. 2. Requirements Preparation & Review: Prepares and reviews procurement documents, supporting papers, Terms of Reference (TOR), technical specifications, and cost estimates. 3. Inter-Office Coordination: Coordinates directly with the Bids and Awards Committee (BAC), Procurement Department, Accounting Office, and other concerned units on all financial and procurement-related matters. 4. Project & Procurement Monitoring: Monitors the implementation and progress of ongoing projects and procurement activities. 5. Inspection, Verification & Quality Assurance: Conducts or assists in the inspection and verification of delivered goods, services, and project outputs to ensure strict conformance to approved TORs, technical specifications, quantity, quality, and required deliverables. 6. Deficiency Reporting & Project Acceptance: Documents and reports deficiencies, discrepancies, or non-compliance in delivery/implementation, and assists in project completion and formal acceptance upon verifying compliance. 7. Post-Procurement & Records Management: Prepares performance evaluations, post-procurement documents, and maintains systematic budget, procurement, inspection, and project monitoring records. 8. Compliance & Audit: Ensures strict adherence to applicable government budgeting, procurement (RA 9184 & *RA 12009), and auditing rules and regulations. 9. Other Duties: Performs other related duties as may be assigned by the immediate supervisor or senior management.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About the Accounting Team The Accounting Team is involved in all aspects of the business ensuring we properly capture, account for, and record all the activities that occur as they occur. We keep the books and records for the Company, help to ensure Thumbtack has appropriate policies and procedures in place, and provide the business with the information in order to make critical decisions in support of Thumbtack’s success. About the role We're looking for a highly skilled Senior Accounting Associate to join our Accounting team. This is a unique opportunity for a motivated professional based in the Philippines to work remotely on a Pacific Time (PT) schedule. You'll be the primary point person for all accounts payable and employee reimbursement activities for Thumbtack globally, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. This role is crucial to our financial operations and requires someone with a strong attention to detail and a proactive, problem-solving mindset. Thumbtack is growing quickly, and so is our finance function. Our systems and processes will change — you should expect this role's scope to evolve, and be genuinely excited to learn new tools, take on adjacent areas, and help implement new systems as we scale. What you’ll do Perform the full cycle of accounts payable, including receiving, processing, verifying, and reconciling invoices for Thumbtack’s US, Canada, and Philippines entities Ensure timely and accurate processing of payments, adhering to company policies and deadlines. Reconcile vendor statements and resolve any discrepancies or issues. Collaborate with various departments to gather necessary approvals and documentation for invoice processing. Own the employee expense report processing tool and process expense reports reviews, approvals, accruals and reconciliations Aid in prepaid preparation and run monthly prepaid amortization in preparation for month end close Assist in the month-end and year-end close processes, specifically related to bank matching, accounts payable accruals, and reconciliations in accordance with US GAAP. Proactively identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy in any of the areas in your work. Support audit requests by providing relevant documentation and explanations. Assist with and/or complete ad hoc projects as requested. Research and document issues, special projects, AP automation, etc. Partner on finance systems changes - evaluating, testing, and implementing new tools or new functionality within existing ones (e.g., NetSuite, Coupa, Navan) — and take on new areas of ownership as the team's scope grows.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Export Coordinator is responsible for supporting the end-to-end export process, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance in handling orders, shipments, and documentation. The role requires close coordination with multiple departments to finalize shippable orders, prepare invoices, manage export records, and address discrepancies to facilitate smooth operations. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 1. Customer / Franchisee Support Provide information and operational support to the Export Merchandiser in addressing customer and Franchisee concerns. Identify and report customer-related discrepancies or issues to the Export Merchandiser for appropriate action. 2. Order Processing & Allocation Generate order data into the ERP system based on PO Qty / ACDR. Process and allocate orders. Identify and report discrepancies in quantities – Prebooked Qty versus PO Qty to the Export Merchandiser before finalization of Export allocation. Prepare and issue Export Allocation for shipment processing to the concerned internal departments. 3. Prices, Invoice & Packing List Preparation Obtain approved prices for non-merchandise items from the VM Team and prepare the Price Level for Audit prior to release to MPC for RPRO uploading. Prepare invoices and packing lists based on approved data and warehouse packing details for review and final release by the Export Merchandiser. Ensure the accuracy and consistency of invoice and packing list information against the audited WH DR. Identify and report pricing or documentation discrepancies to the Export Merchandiser. 4. Shipment Status & Export Documentation Update shipment records and prepare required export and shipment documentation based on approved schedules and assigned priorities. Provide required data and documentation to Production, QC, Warehouse, MPCD, Audit, and other concerned departments. Execute assigned shipment priorities and documentation requirements within the specified timelines. Monitor the Export Daily Shipping Status via Google Drive and ensure timely updates. Identify and escalate significant issues that may delay the invoicing or shipping process to the Export Merchandiser. 5. Non-Merchandise Orders Process Franchisee non-merchandise orders, including Packaging Supplies, SPD items, and VM items, based on approved requirements. Prepare invoices, packing lists, order sheets, and related documentation for review and final release by the Export Merchandiser. 6. Export Records & Administrative Support Maintain and update export databases, order records, invoices, packing lists, and other required export documentation. Ensure systematic and timely filing of export records and supporting documents. Escalate issues through the Export Merchandiser; urgent matters shall be escalated to the Export Manager as directed. Perform other export-related duties as assigned by the Export Manager.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: MedGrocer’s digitally-enabled corporate healthcare solutions empower our customers to get their medicines, vaccines, and teleconsultations conveniently, cost-effectively, and intelligently. In this role, you will gain hands-on leadership experience across customer service and supply chain workflows while driving process and system improvements to support rapid organizational scaling. The selective MT program only accepts candidates with academic excellence, organizational leadership, and other exceptional qualities. Candidates who do not qualify as MTs will still be considered for alternative roles. Manage day-to-day operations relating to customer service or supply chain. Manage, train, and provide learning and growth opportunities to the team. Coordinate with customers and partners. Address, investigate, and resolve major operational concerns. Manage databases and monitors key performance indicators. Growth & Impact : A clear path for professional development and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on patient health. Cross-Functional Learning : Opportunities to collaborate across different teams, expanding your skill set and broadening your understanding of the business. Health & Wellness Coverage : HMO benefits to ensure your peace of mind, paired with free medical consultations and unlimited essential medicines. Paid Time Off : Paid leaves to rest, recharge, and attend to personal priorities. HR will notify you if your evaluation concludes early. Please arrive at the venue between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM. The detailed schedule is as follows: Initial Assessment 8:00 AM - 10:00 AM : Onsite Assessment Supplementary Assessment (as needed) 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM : HR Panel Interview 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM : Lunch Break 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM : One-on-One Interviews 4:00 PM – 5:30 PM : CEO Forum Step 3 : Final review and background checks occur within three business days. deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Store Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the store to ensure the achievement of sales targets, efficient personnel management, proper inventory and cash control, excellent customer service, and compliance with company policies and procedures. The role involves leading the store team, maintaining operational excellence, and ensuring a positive shopping experience for customers. Location: SM Sta. Rosa – Just G Boutique Key Responsibilities 1. Sales Management and Business Performance Achieve monthly sales targets and store quotas for assigned brands. Collaborate with the Area Sales Supervisor/Manager in developing and implementing sales strategies and promotional activities. Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue and profitability. Address and resolve issues affecting store sales and overall business performance. Coordinate with the Merchandise Planning and Control Department regarding merchandise requests, stock movement, and inventory requirements. Prepare and submit required sales reports, including: Weekly Sales Report Month-End Summary Report Categorical Sales Report Monthly Work Schedule Ensure the delivery of excellent customer service and effectively handle customer concerns, complaints, and inquiries. 2. Personnel Management Supervise, motivate, and evaluate the performance of store personnel, including Customer Assistants (CA) and Customer Sales Associates (CSA). Prepare, monitor, and manage employee work schedules, including opening and closing shifts, day-offs, holidays, sale events, and schedule adjustments. Conduct store-level training and retraining programs to enhance employee skills and performance. Communicate company policies, operational updates, and instructions to staff through regular meetings and briefings. Ensure compliance with company rules, policies, and procedures. Address employee concerns, resolve workplace issues, and recommend disciplinary actions when necessary. 3. Inventory, Cash, and Asset Management Implement and enforce inventory control systems and audit procedures. Monitor stock levels and report overstock and understock situations to maintain optimal inventory levels. Minimize merchandise damages and prepare monthly Merchandise Damage Reports. Oversee cashier operations and monitor cash handling procedures. Report cash shortages, overages, and deviations from established cashiering policies and procedures. Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and safeguarding of store assets, supplies, and equipment. Promote cost-effective management of store resources. 4. Store Image and Visual Merchandising Ensure consistent implementation of company visual merchandising standards and store image guidelines. Identify and report visual merchandising concerns and recommend improvements. Participate in the planning and execution of sales promotions and marketing campaigns. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and overall housekeeping standards within the store. 5. Administrative and Operational Support Coordinate with mall administration, leasing officers, suppliers, contractors, banks, and other external stakeholders regarding operational requirements and concerns. Facilitate compliance with operational, safety, and regulatory requirements. Perform administrative and operational tasks as assigned by the Area Sales Supervisor/Manager. Support company initiatives and special projects as required.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Position Overview : We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Credit and Collections Associate to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the credit evaluation process, monitoring outstanding balances, and ensuring timely collections from clients. Collections: Contact clients to collect outstanding payments in a timely and professional manner, ensuring compliance with company policies. Payment Processing: Track incoming payments, accurately apply them to customer accounts, and resolve any discrepancies. Account Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile customer accounts to ensure balances are accurate and up to date. Aging Report Management: Maintain and monitor accounts receivable aging reports, following up on overdue accounts and escalating problematic cases as needed. Customer Communication: Build and maintain relationships with customers to resolve billing and payment issues, and negotiate payment plans when necessary. Credit Limits & Terms: Recommend credit limits and payment terms based on company guidelines and credit risk assessment. Dispute Resolution: Work with internal departments (sales, customer service, etc.) to resolve billing disputes and ensure smooth resolution. Reporting: Prepare regular reports on collection efforts, credit issues, and overall account status for management review. Compliance: Ensure that all credit and collection activities comply with company policies and legal regulations. Documentation: Maintain detailed records of all collection activities, communications, and payment arrangements.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Supply Chain Optimization: Continuously evaluate the supply chain processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. Risk Management: Identify potential risks in the supply chain (delays, disruptions, etc.) and implement strategies to mitigate them. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, such as sales, logistics, and finance, to ensure smooth operations and communication across the supply chain. Reporting: Prepare and present reports on procurement activities, supplier performance, and supply chain metrics.

This role works closely with Design, R&D, Sourcing, Production, Warehouse, QA/QC, and Logistics teams to ensure material readiness, cost control, production efficiency, and timely delivery. Key Responsibilities: 1. Production Planning & Coordination ﻿Monitor order status from development through pre-production. Establish collection timelines and key milestones. Coordinate production schedules and readiness with the Production team. Ensure all requirements and approvals are completed before bulk production. Track Work-in-Progress (WIP) and address bottlenecks affecting delivery. 2. Buyer Coordination & Order Management Support order acquisition from local and export buyers. ﻿﻿Serve as the primary contact for buyer inquiries, updates, and concerns. Maintain effective communication to ensure alignment on requirements and timelines. 3. Product Development Support Work closely with Design, R&D, and Pattern teams during product development. Monitor proto, fit, and pre-production sample progress. ﻿﻿Ensure timely completion and approval of all development samples. 4. Costing Review & Analysis Review indicative and actual costing for each style. Analyze material, service, shipping, and related costs. Recommend cost-effective alternatives without compromising quality or design. ﻿﻿Monitor margin performance by style and collection. Coordinate with R&D to ensure pricing accuracy and cost optimization. 5. Style Engineering & Process Improvement Recommend style modifications to improve production efficiency and reduce sewing SAM. Propose alternative trims, materials, or construction methods to optimize costs. Identify opportunities for continuous process improvement. 6. Technical Coordination Ensure garments meet functionality, comfort, durability, and safety requirements for children's apparel. Monitor compliance of trims and accessories with applicable safety standards. Ensure garment construction supports comfort, mobility, and practicality. Review key product requirements such as safety compliance, soft hand feel, wash durability, and child-friendly closures. 7. Material Monitoring Coordinate with PR/R&D and Warehouse teams to ensure timely material availability. ﻿﻿Verify material completeness before production starts. Monitor allocation versus actual consumption. ﻿﻿Escalate shortages and recommend corrective actions. 8. Cross-Functional Coordination Act as the key liaison among Design, PR/R&D, Costing, Production, Warehouse, QA/QC, and Logistics teams. Ensure alignment on production readiness, delivery priorities, and collection timelines. 9. Reporting & Performance Analysis Prepare and update daily WIP reports and collection monitoring tools. Analyze delivery performance, delays, and operational bottlenecks. ﻿﻿Recommend improvements to productivity and on-time delivery. ﻿﻿Present collection and production performance updates to management.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: We're an automotive styling company looking for an HR Officer who can take full ownership of our people operations — from hiring and onboarding to policies, compliance, and employee relations. This is not a role where every decision needs sign-off. We want someone who can assess a situation, make a sound call, and keep us informed — not someone who needs a checklist for every task. If you enjoy building HR systems from the ground up, thrive with autonomy, and are comfortable being the go-to person for all things people-related, this role is for you. What You'll Own Recruitment & Hiring — Manage the full hiring cycle: job postings, screening, interviews, offers, and onboarding. Policies & Compliance — Develop, update, and enforce HR policies in line with local labor law; keep the company compliant on statutory requirements (contracts, benefits, leave, etc.). Employee Relations — Serve as the first point of contact for employee concerns, conflicts, and grievances; handle these with discretion and fairness. Payroll & Benefits Coordination — Oversee or coordinate payroll processing, government-mandated benefits, and any company benefits programs. Performance Management — Set up and run basic performance review processes; support managers with coaching, warnings, or performance improvement plans when needed. Records & Documentation — Maintain accurate, confidential employee records and HR documentation. Culture & Engagement — Propose and run initiatives that keep the team engaged and the workplace healthy, without needing to be told to do so. HR Reporting — Provide periodic summaries to leadership on headcount, turnover, hiring pipeline, and any issues worth flagging — proactively, not just when asked.

Performs other university-related duties as may be required by the immediate supervisor and any authorized representatives

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary of Work Activities and Responsibilities: The Admission Officer provides communications, marketing, and applicant support services for the Junior High School (JHS) Office of Admission and Scholarships (OAS). The position also manages the online admission application portal and assists the OAS Coordinator in implementing admissions-related activities, including data summaries, entrance exams, and office communications. Main Duties and Responsibilities: I. Application and Admissions Support Responds to inquiries from potential applicants, parents, schools, and teacher-recommenders through email or other communication channel Oversees the maintenance and updating of the JHS online admission application portal Troubleshoots issues related to the online admission application portal, supporting users through every stage of the application process Coordinates with the Digital Information and Technology Services (DITS) in fixing issues/repairs and other technical requests being requested by developers Communicates enrollment eligibility to accepted applicants, provides step-by-step enrollment guidelines, and follows up to confirm their intent to enroll Drafts and sends decision letters and responses to appeals, under the guidance of the OAS Coordinator Monitors the completeness and progress of all submitted applications across the various stages of the admissions process, ensuring that requirements are met and timelines are followed Reviews submitted application accounts for accuracy and readiness for submission Checks and records payment status to confirm eligibility for application review Mobilizes and coordinates with staff or faculty volunteers for the review and evaluation of applications Prepares applicant data summaries and recommendation records to support the admissions decision-making process Assists in the preparation and the actual conduct of the entrance exams Prepares exam materials, room assignments and proctoring schedules II. Marketing and Promotion Contributes to the development and execution of the JHS annual marketing plan for admissions Prepares draft proposals, marketing activity calendars and initial content ideas for review by the OAS Coordinator Develops and releases official announcements and updates on JHS admissions, including application timelines and requirements Drafts and updates promotional materials (e.g., brochures, website content) to communicate JHS offerings and identity to prospective applicants in coordination with the University Marketing and Communications Office (UMCO) Sends targeted communications to prospective applicants based on school partnerships, demographics, or identified recruitment priorities Conducts recruitment talks and presentations when requested III. Performs other work-related tasks as may be required by the immediate supervisor and authorized representative

Ensures that goods are delivered to the right client at the right time and place. 2. Delivers and collects samples from clients. 3. Performs tasks that affect the delivery process such as but not limited to the following: Preparation of necessary forms Complete required forms for delivery Safe and efficient loading and unloading of goods Inventory audit of goods for delivery Safety of goods, equipment and people within the delivery vehicle Arrangement of goods in the delivery vehicle 4. Coordinates with the Delivery Assistant and Warehouse Supervisor in the development, monitoring and evaluation of plans to promote the efficiency of delivery. 5. deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary of Work Activities and Responsibilities: Under the direct supervision of the Central Facilities Management Office (CFMO) Section Head for Facilities Budget and Purchasing, the Facilities Budget Account Staff monitors budget disbursement, assists in the preparation of the yearly office budget proposal, and provides budget and finance-related assistance to the other Section Heads, Group Heads and the CFMO Director. Ensures section services meet set standards and are delivered promptly. Recommends policies and strategies to enhance customer service and operational processes. Coordinates with school units on budget-related concerns. Assists in the preparation of documents for accreditation and assessments Maintains online records of overtime, agency cleaners, projects, and furniture/equipment requests. Drafts and transcribes letters, announcements, reports, and meeting minutes as assigned. II. Budget Disbursement and Monitoring Support Supports CFMO Section Heads in preparing and tracking budgets and fund disbursements. Prepares and processes Electronic Request for Payment System, Electronic Purchase Requisitions, and funding requests for various accounts, including: Major/Minor Improvements Capitalized & Non-Capitalized Furniture and Equipment Meetings, Events, Representation Retreat, Laundry, IT & Software Expenses Ensures all required attachments for purchases are complete and submitted to Central Accounting Office and Central Purchasing Office. Maintains and updates budget ledgers, providing monthly balance reports. Prepares final proposed budgets by unit and section for the Section Head’s review. Monitors Purchase Orders and submits Receiving Reports to the Facilities Assistant. Verifies invoices and billing statements; ensures timely payment and accurate billing. Evaluates purchase requests against assigned budgets. Maintains organized filing of budget-related documents. Oversees petty cash replenishment, disbursement, and liquidation of cash advances. Drafts annual budget proposals for capital and non-capital expenses and submits them for review. Handles day-to-day frontline and administrative tasks related to assigned budget accounts. Coordinates with suppliers and contractors for invoices, completion certificates, and other concerns. Participates in bidding processes and provides budget-related feedback to the Section Head. Ensures timely submission of invoices and documents to Central Accounting Office and Central Purchasing Office. III. Other Duties Performs other work-related tasks as assigned by the Section Head for Facilities Budget and Purchasing.

Ensures section services meet set standards and are delivered promptly. Recommends policies and strategies to enhance customer service and operational processes. Coordinates with school units on budget-related concerns. Assists in the preparation of documents for accreditation and assessments Maintains online records of overtime, agency cleaners, projects, and furniture/equipment requests. Drafts and transcribes letters, announcements, reports, and meeting minutes as assigned. II. Budget Disbursement and Monitoring Support Supports CFMO Section Heads in preparing and tracking budgets and fund disbursements. Prepares and processes Electronic Request for Payment System, Electronic Purchase Requisitions, and funding requests for various accounts, including: Major/Minor Improvements Capitalized & Non-Capitalized Furniture and Equipment Meetings, Events, Representation Retreat, Laundry, IT & Software Expenses Ensures all required attachments for purchases are complete and submitted to Central Accounting Office and Central Purchasing Office. Maintains and updates budget ledgers, providing monthly balance reports. Prepares final proposed budgets by unit and section for the Section Head’s review. Monitors Purchase Orders and submits Receiving Reports to the Facilities Assistant. Verifies invoices and billing statements; ensures timely payment and accurate billing. Evaluates purchase requests against assigned budgets. Maintains organized filing of budget-related documents. Oversees petty cash replenishment, disbursement, and liquidation of cash advances. Drafts annual budget proposals for capital and non-capital expenses and submits them for review. Handles day-to-day frontline and administrative tasks related to assigned budget accounts. Coordinates with suppliers and contractors for invoices, completion certificates, and other concerns. Participates in bidding processes and provides budget-related feedback to the Section Head. Ensures timely submission of invoices and documents to Central Accounting Office and Central Purchasing Office. III. Other Duties Performs other work-related tasks as assigned by the Section Head for Facilities Budget and Purchasing.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: We are seeking 2 (two) analytical, tech-forward Finance Managers to lead the financial operations and strategic accounting for our Philippine operating companies -either for Remedy Skintech Inc. or Healthspan Global Inc. This role is built for a proactive finance professional who wants to act as a true business partner to either our Clinic Operations (Remedy) or Sales Team (Healthspan). We don’t just want someone to report the numbers—we need someone to tell us why. You will work closely with the Group Finance Manager and the clinic operators/sales to steer the business, optimize operational performance, and translate raw data into actionable insights that drive clinic profitability and exceptional patient experiences. Innovation is at the core of our finance team. You must be comfortable with Artificial Intelligence and modern software tools, eager to build and implement automation. Your goal will be to systemize routine accounting tasks so that you and your team can focus on high-value Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) that moves the needle for the company. Prepares timely and accurate financial reports for the review of the Group Finance Manager to support business reviews and group consolidation Ensures local compliance and prepares tax filings under Philippine tax laws and Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS) Manages local vendor relationships, supply chain financing, and procurement transactions to protect working capital Supervises, coaches, and develops the F&A team by identifying training needs and development plans Conducts performance evaluations and manages the day-to-day productivity of the F&A team Implements department policies, processes, and protocols, and recommends improvements Conducts on-site visits as required by operations Communicates all Management directives and department goals to team members

deskripsi_pekerjaan: We are seeking a visionary and data-driven Senior SEO and GEO Manager to lead our organic visibility strategy into the next era of search. In this role, you won't just optimize for algorithms; you will optimize for user intent across traditional search engines (ex. Google) and AI-driven generative engines (OpenAI/ChatGPT, Gemini, and the like). The ideal candidate understands that modern SEO is actually SXO (Search Experience Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). You will be responsible for ensuring our agency's clients are not only ranked but cited, recommended, and integrated into the conversational answers providing the framework for tomorrow's internet. Summary LLM Visibility & Citation Strategy: Optimize content architecture to ensure our brand is pulled into AI summaries and Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and other Large Language Model (LLM) platforms. Brand Footprint Management: Monitor and improve the brand's sentiment and data presence across LLM training sets and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) sources. Conversational Keyword Research: Shift keyword strategies from rigid short-tail queries to natural language, long-tail conversational prompts used in AI chats. Entity & Schema Architecture: Implement advanced structured data and schema markup to help search engines and AI models map our content as verified "entities." Technical Health: Oversee crawlability, indexability, site speed, and Core Web Vitals, ensuring a flawless foundation for both bots and users. Programmatic & Scalable SEO: Identify opportunities for scalable content deployment without sacrificing editorial quality. Marketing Strategy: Understand the overall strategy developed for the client, and clearly identify how SEO & GEO fit in this picture. Information Gain Optimization: Move past generic content to focus on "Information Gain", creating original insights, proprietary data, and unique perspectives that AI engines prioritize for citations E-E-A-T Enforcement: Drive strategies that solidify our team's Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness across the web. Contextual Backlinking: Focus on high-authority, contextually relevant backlinks that serve as validation nodes for AI discovery engines. Next-Gen Reporting: Establish KPIs that look beyond traditional rankings, tracking "Share of Voice" in AI overviews, LLM referral traffic, and conversational search visibility. Data-Driven Pivots: Utilize standard tools (GA4, Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush) alongside emerging GEO tracking platforms to measure ROI. Client Strategy & Presentations: Present SEO, GEO, and AI search strategies, campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to clients and stakeholders through clear, data-driven presentations and strategic consultations. Team Leadership & Mentorship: Provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance to junior SEO specialists and team members, supporting their professional development while promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Quality Assurance: Review and provide constructive feedback on SEO deliverables, technical audits, content recommendations, and optimization plans prepared by junior team members to ensure quality and strategic alignment. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Account Management, Content, Creative, Web Development, Paid Media, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated digital marketing solutions. Other related duties as required or assigned

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Brief The Campaign and Promotions Lead is responsible for managing and executing promotional campaigns that effectively communicate the brand’s message, engage the target audience, and drive business growth. This role involves overseeing the entire lifecycle of promotional activities, from conceptualization to performance analysis, ensuring that each campaign aligns with broader marketing strategies and business objectives. The Campaign and Promotions Lead also collaborates with cross-functional teams and manages external partnerships to ensure cohesive and impactful campaigns. Duties & Responsibilities 1. Campaign Development Design and implement innovative promotional campaigns that align with the company’s marketing goals, enhance brand visibility, and drive audience engagement. Collaborate closely with the Creative Production Lead to ensure campaign materials align with brand messaging and are tailored to target audience preferences. 2. Strategy Formulation Develop strategic marketing plans for promotions that integrate with sales objectives and reflect market trends, ensuring that campaigns are aligned with business goals. Implement multi-platform lead development strategies to maximize campaign reach and engagement. 3. Team Management Lead, mentor, and manage a team of marketing professionals, providing guidance on campaign strategy, execution, and promotional content development. Foster a collaborative team environment, ensuring alignment across marketing, sales, and product teams to achieve shared goals. 4. Budget Management Oversee the budget for promotional campaigns, ensuring efficient allocation of resources to maximize effectiveness and return on investment. Track expenditures and adjust spending as necessary to meet budgetary and performance targets. 5. Performance Analysis Measure and evaluate the effectiveness of promotional campaigns using key performance indicators (KPIs), including engagement rates, impressions, web page views, and lead generation. Analyze data and provide recommendations for optimization and improved performance in future campaigns. 6. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Sales, Product Development, and Customer Service teams to ensure marketing campaigns are fully integrated with business operations and support product launches and sales objectives. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive and effective promotional efforts. 7. Vendor and Stakeholder Relations Manage relationships with external vendors, media agencies, and partners to secure promotional spaces, materials, and media placements. Negotiate contracts and maintain productive partnerships to ensure successful campaign execution. 8. Market Research and Insights Conduct thorough market research to stay informed of customer trends, competitor strategies, and emerging opportunities. Leverage insights to shape promotional strategies that resonate with target audiences and enhance campaign outcomes.

The Installation Engineer will install modular cabinets, wardrobes, wall panels, furniture, doors, glass windows and doors, curtains and blinds, and other architectural interior products. This role requires strong spatial reasoning, technical understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to troubleshoot site conditions and installation issues in real time. The ideal candidate is hands-on, technically minded, and comfortable working on construction and interior fit-out sites. They should be able to identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions, coordinate with contractors and other trades, and ensure that every installation meets the required dimensions, alignment, functionality, and finish quality.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: SeriousMD is the EMR and practice management platform used by doctors across the Philippines — records, scheduling, teleconsults, billing, and analytics in one app. NowServing is the patient side: it's how patients find those doctors and book them. We're opening territories and need people who already have doctor relationships to work them. Your job is to get doctors on the platform, get them actually using it, and introduce them to the clinical programs we run on it — weight management among them, with more coming. If you're an active med rep with an existing route, a former rep with relationships still intact, or a clinic-side professional with a strong doctor network, this is built to fit alongside what you already do. Scope of Engagement Cover doctors in your territory — clinic visits, hospital medical arts buildings, and follow-ups. Build the route and work it consistently. Demo the platform live on a phone or laptop, in the five minutes you get between a doctor's patients. Onboard new doctors and walk them through setup — first patient record, first booking, first teleconsult. Sign-up is the start of your work, not the end. Introduce and enroll doctors into our clinical programs, explaining how each one runs on the platform and what it means for their practice. Train clinic secretaries and staff, who often determine whether the tool actually gets used day to day. Work the relationships that matter — secretaries and clinic staff are the gatekeepers, and they decide whether you get five minutes or none. Handle first-line questions and issues; escalate technical problems to support and close the loop with the doctor. Keep your pipeline and visit records current, and report on coverage, sign-ups, and active usage. Represent us at conventions, specialty society meetings, and hospital events.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Summary The Material Disposal Manager for Garments is responsible for managing the disposal of excess, obsolete, slow-moving, and expiring raw materials, including fabrics, trims, end cuts, and other approved inventories. The position oversees the entire disposal process, from inventory validation and buyer sourcing to negotiation, documentation, and inventory release, to ensure timely disposition, maximize recovery value, and support efficient warehouse operations. Key Duties and Responsibilities Raw Material Disposal Plans and coordinates the disposal of approved raw materials in accordance with established Company policies and procedures. Works with Warehouse and other concerned departments to verify inventories and confirm items for disposal. Monitors inventory aging and recommends appropriate disposal strategies. Buyer Development and Commercial Negotiation Develops and maintains a network of qualified stocklot buyers and prospective customers. Represents the Company during buyer meetings, warehouse inspections, bidding activities, and commercial negotiations. Negotiates selling prices, payment terms, and disposal agreements in coordination with Accounting and Management. Documentation and Process Control Ensures that all disposal transactions are properly documented, approved, and supported by complete records before inventory release. Maintains disposal records and buyer database. Recommends improvements to disposal procedures and internal controls. Reporting Prepares regular reports on disposal activities, recovery value, and inventory status. Performs other related duties that may be assigned by Management. Key Accountabilities Timely disposal of approved raw materials. Achievement of target recovery value. Development of a reliable stocklot buyer network. Compliance with approved disposal procedures and documentation requirements. Efficient utilization of warehouse space.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: A Garment Merchandiser serves as the critical link between buyers and production teams. They oversee the entire lifecycle of an apparel order-from initial product development, costing, and material sourcing to factory scheduling, quality assurance, and final shipment delivery. Key Responsibilities: Act as the primary point of contact for international or domestic clients. Clarify order specifications (design, quantities, pricing) and maintain detailed internal order sheets. Coordinate sample development (proto, pre-production, and size sets) and secure buyer approvals for fabric, colors, lab dips, and trims. Negotiate costs with vendors, source raw materials (fabrics, accessories), and raise purchase orders (POs) while staying within the allocated budget. Create and strictly manage the Time and Action (TNA) calendar to ensure all production stages happen on schedule. Proactively solve supply chain delays. Coordinate with the Quality Assurance (QA) team for inline and final inspections. Oversee export documentation, packaging, and coordinate with freight forwarders to ensure on-time delivery.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary of Work Activities and Responsibilities: The Visa Compliance Officer facilitates and ensures the University’s compliance with Philippine laws and policies relevant to inbound non-Filipino students / academics / other personnel, as well as outbound Ateneo students / academics / other personnel. The Visa Compliance Officer reports directly to the Head of the International Mobility Section of the OAVP-UPI, and oversees the work of the Visa Processing Assistant and the Visa Liaison. Main Duties and Responsibilities: 1. Compliance Management Support: Surveys and keeps abreast of all relevant information about laws, regulatory requirements, policies, protocols, and other such guidelines, that are pertinent to the mobility of students, academics, and other personnel. Surveys and keeps abreast of all relevant information on processes, requirements, and timelines of the application for relevant permits and visas that are necessary to enable the mobility of students, academics, and other personnel. Liaises with relevant government agencies to ensure that information related to mobility and necessary permits is up-to-date and accurate. These agencies include but are not limited to Department of Labor and Employment, Bureau of Immigration, Professional Regulatory Commission, and Commission on Higher Education. Assists the Head of the International Mobility Section in the conduct of reviews of University policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure compliance with government regulations related to international inbound and outbound mobility of students, academics, and other personnel. Provides effective guidance to concerned University units, especially academic departments, about application requirements, supporting documents, and processing timelines for appropriate visas and permits that are necessary for both inbound and outbound mobility of students, academics, and other personnel. Oversees the system designed to monitor the expiration dates of relevant permits and visas, and triggers the issuance of timely advisories in anticipation of such expiration dates. Submits and tracks requests for cash advances and liquidation of all visa-related procedure Provides guidance to University offices regarding regulation compliance reporting requirements, and reviews and facilitates the submission of such to government regulatory agencies. 2. Reports and Documentation Support Reviews and endorses reports related to mobility of students, academics, and personnel in compliance with government and regulatory agencies. Collates, analyzes, and presents data related to requested endorsement processing services and actual administration, and all pertinent data related to the applied endorsements 3. Section Management Support Assists the Head of the International Mobility Section in supervising and managing the combined work of the Visa Processing Assistant and the Visa Liaison. Assists in the efficient and effective usage of the Visa Revolving Fund, in accordance with University guidelines and protocols that govern such resources. Provides advice to the Section Head regarding complementary resource requirements of the Visa Team which may improve productivity and efficiency. 4. Performs other university-related duties as may be required by the immediate supervisor and any authorized representatives

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Main Duties and Responsibilities: I. Attendance Processing and Management Manages the attendance reports and records of all Maintenance Staff. Serves as point-person regarding leave records and reports, and ensures timely response to questions and concerns. Receives weekly attendance data extracted from the system. Checks for completeness and validates actual entry times with the Heads, and with the security, if needed. Verifies missing entries against filed leaves and daily log record. Works with the supervisors in implementing changes, if needed. Prepares reports and secures signatures/approvals. Facilitates the processing and submission of attendance records and leaves to the Total Records Section of the University HR Operations Shared Services Office. Updates records of remaining leaves of employees, and sends leave records/balances to employees as needed. Receives, consolidates, and monitors Daily Time Records for approved overtime work of assigned employees. Coordinates with Supervisors and Heads for concerns Checks the accuracy of Daily Time Recordsfor overtime work rendered, and endorses for required signatures and approvals Maintains the online attendance tracker for reference of Heads and Group Heads II. Office Equipment and Records Management Maintains inventory records of consolidated office equipment and tools. Checks office equipment, tools, and supplies for the unit. Coordinates with the Budget and Finance Section for monitoring and updating of records. Works with the Purchasing and Inventory Staff of the Budget and Purchasing Section in monitoring assigned equipment and tools to staff. Tracks retrieval of tools and equipment, to ensure inventory of office equipment and tools are in order. III. Keys Management Maintains records and safekeeps physical copies of all campus keys. Checks and validates each key and label to verify if they are updated. Checks and/or places validated keys in the key storage cabinet, to ensure that they are placed in their appropriate slots. Receives and reviews forms for requests for duplicates or replacement of door knobs and locks, to ensure that they are duly signed and approved by the unit head Coordinates the schedule of replacement of door knobs and locks with the requesting unit and the Post Construction and Building Care Section. Prepares requested duplicates of keys, labels them accordingly, and records the work performed for monitoring. Receives email requests for borrowing of duplicate keys. Verifies validity of request, facilitates the lending and retrieval of the borrowed keys, and documents as needed. Ensures the accuracy of key records, by coordinating with the Planning and Design Section for any possible changes concerning relocation of sections, offices, etc. Updates records for validated changes. Collects copies of keys from the assigned custodian of former occupants, and safekeeps them in the storage cabinet for keys. Facilitates the dispensing of keys to designated custodian of new occupants. Monitors and ensures that the key storage cabinet is locked and secured at all times. Enrolls fingerprints for biometric and keycode security systems in the campus. Receives requests for access to areas secured by biometric and keycode security systems, and verifies if the requests are valid and approved. Coordinates the enrollment of the new employee in the system. Performs the enrollment and documents accordingly. IV. Performs other duties as may be assigned by the immediate supervisor, or any authorized representative.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Workforce Analyst supports the Workforce Lead/Manager and operational teams in workforce planning, capacity coordination, skills tracking, and resource optimization. The role monitors, analyzes, and consolidates workforce data to ensure proper allocation of resources, alignment of skills to project needs, and timely support for staffing decisions. The Workforce Analyst provides data-driven insights that help the organization improve utilization, plan for demand, and make informed resourcing decisions. Coordinates the execution of workforce planning activities based on approved strategies and action plans. Monitors resource allocation across projects and identifies inefficiencies or discrepancies that may impact delivery performance or project profitability; escalates findings to the Workforce Lead/Manager. Consolidates and reviews information related to resources’ performance, skills, and capabilities to support effective workforce allocation decisions. Coordinates with Delivery and Sales by providing capacity and skills visibility needed for project assignments, potential replacements, and upcoming opportunities. Works with TAG (Talent Acquisition Group) by supplying timely demand and supply data, and provides input to help assess whether internal resources or external hiring may be required. Coordinates updates to the workforce database to ensure accuracy of resource availability, skills profiles, competency levels, certifications, and project assignments. Analyzes workforce data (skills trends, patterns, capacity signals) to help identify skills gaps and support the development of capability-building plans. Supports the development and maintenance of a skills library by consolidating data on demand and supply trends across accounts or projects. Ensures workforce productivity standards are monitored and flags risks to the Workforce Lead/Manager. Performs other related duties as may be required by the immediate supervisor and authorized representatives.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: About Rembox Rembox is a team of architects, engineers, BIM managers, and visualizers united by an ambitious goal: to design beautiful cities and bring incredible projects to life with passion and professionalism. We collaborate with renowned studios from Israel and the USA, transforming large-scale ideas into reality. With over 500 staff across four offices in Belarus (Minsk, Brest, Grodno, and Gomel), Rembox is expanding into the Philippines and seeking talented engineering professionals to join us. We serve as a strategic partner for leading design organizations in Israel and the United States, delivering architectural, structural, MEP, and BIM services for large-scale projects across residential, commercial, public, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. About the Role Rembox Philippines is looking for a skilled and motivated Electrical Power Supply Design Engineer. You will design internal and external power supply systems and produce complete electrical drawings and documentation for projects of various scales, collaborating with international project teams. Key Responsibilities External Power Supply Systems Design external power supply infrastructure, including high and medium voltage networks, substations, transformer connections, and cable routing. Design external distribution systems, including overhead lines, underground cable networks, switching stations, and metering points. Produce drawings and documentation for external electrical networks: plans, cable routing layouts, schematic diagrams, and connection details. Internal Power Supply Systems Design internal low voltage distribution systems: main distribution boards, sub-distribution panels, busbar trunking, and cable distribution. Design internal electrical systems for buildings: lighting, power outlets, socket layouts, emergency lighting, and UPS systems. Design emergency and standby power systems: generator connections, automatic transfer switches, and critical load distribution. Design earthing and lightning protection systems. Produce internal electrical drawings: floor plans, riser diagrams, single-line diagrams, load calculations, and cable schedules. Documentation & Coordination Produce complete electrical engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD, including plans, schematics, single-line diagrams, sections, details, and specifications. Develop and maintain electrical BIM models in Autodesk Revit where required, adhering to project BIM standards. Create electrical designs for projects of various scales and typologies, including residential complexes, public buildings, office developments, industrial, and infrastructure. Coordinate electrical designs with architectural, structural, mechanical, and plumbing disciplines to resolve clashes and ensure integration. Ensure all designs comply with applicable international codes, standards, and project specifications. Update documentation based on design revisions, coordination outcomes, and client feedback. Participate in technical coordination meetings and contribute to project delivery. What Rembox Offers Employment via B2B contract. Work on interesting, large-scale international projects in Israel and the USA. Opportunities for professional growth and self-fulfillment within a growing global company. Exposure to new technologies, including work in the BIM environment. A collaborative, people-centered work culture with like-minded engineering professionals. Clear pathway to grow alongside the company as the Manila office expands. Be part of the founding team of Rembox Philippines — a unique opportunity at an exciting stage.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Main Responsibilities: The Equity Sales Trader is responsible for executing trades, maintaining and expanding client relationships, and supporting sales and trading operations. This role demands exceptional attention to detail to ensure accurate trade execution, precise account maintenance, and strict compliance with regulatory requirements. The Equity Sales Trader must be able to work independently during trading sessions and handle high-frequency, high-volume transactions without compromising accuracy or the Best Execution Rule under the SRC (Securities Regulation Code). The position also requires strong public speaking skills, the ability to confidently address clients or stakeholders—even on short notice—and at least basic knowledge of research and analysis. The ideal candidate is committed to continuous learning, open to enrolling in all necessary studies, courses, training, and workshops, and willing to obtain and pass any additional licenses required in the future. Flexibility to work in both hybrid and full on-site arrangements is also required. Duties and Responsibilities: Execute, maintain, and grow relationships with house accounts, institutional accounts, retail accounts, and done-through accounts. Proactively engage in relationship‑building activities, including attending industry and social events with institutional and high‑net‑worth clients. Provide meticulous execution support to traders, sales agents, and their clients, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Act as the primary point of contact for CAIF (Customer Account Information Form) updates for the Traditional and Institutional Sales Team, with careful attention to completeness and correctness. Serve as the sales liaison for accreditation renewals and applications, ensuring all documentation is properly prepared and submitted. Act as a backup for other traders and dealers in order execution, with zero‑error handling of trades. Represent the company in meetings, presentations, and public events, delivering clear and confident messages, even with minimal preparation time. Apply basic research and analysis skills to support market insights, client servicing, and trade execution strategies. Actively pursue professional development by participating in relevant studies, courses, trainings, and workshops. Obtain and pass all additional licenses required to perform the role effectively and comply with future industry or regulatory requirements. Independently handle high-frequency and high-volume trades during market hours while maintaining precision and full compliance with the SRC Best Execution Rule.
