nama_pekerjaan: HR Governance, Compliance and Contract Risk Manager
deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Summary This role establishes and maintains the Company’s HR governance and compliance framework, ensuring adherence to labor laws, internal policies, and contractual risk standards. The role serves as the organization’s subject matter expert in labor compliance and employee relations, while conducting structured risk reviews of commercial contracts to protect the Company from legal, financial, and reputational exposure. It functions as a risk control and compliance gatekeeper, working closely with Legal, Finance, and relevant business units to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place before execution. Main Responsibilities: 1. Labor Law Compliance & HR Governance Interpret and apply Philippine labor laws, DOLE issuances, and related regulations. Ensure compliance with statutory labor standards and internal HR policies. Monitor regulatory developments and recommend policy or process adjustments. Conduct HR compliance reviews and risk assessments. Maintain and strengthen HR governance frameworks, controls, and documentation standards. 2. Employee Relations & Case Management Lead and oversee complex employee relations matters, including investigations, due process proceedings, disciplinary actions, grievances, harassment and misconduct, performance cases, and termination/separation matters. Prepare, review, and ensure the legal defensibility of employee relations documentation, including Notices to Explain (NTEs), Notices of Hearing, disciplinary decisions, memoranda, settlement agreements, case summaries, and reports. 3. Contract Risk Review & Governance Review commercial contracts to identify and mitigate legal, financial, and reputational risks. Assess contractual obligations, deliverables, liability, indemnity, risk allocation, termination, cancellation, breach, and other key provisions. Identify ambiguous or unfavorable terms and recommend revisions to strengthen the Company’s legal and commercial protection. Establish minimum contract risk standards, particularly for influencer and KOL engagements. Develop review checklists and risk assessment frameworks and ensure consistent application of contract review protocols. Maintain documentation of contract risk decisions and approvals and escalate high-risk matters to Legal and Management. Coordinate with Legal for final contract validation when necessary. 4. Policy Development & Interpretation Develop, review, and update HR policies and governance guidelines. Ensure policies are legally compliant, clear, and enforceable. Provide guidance on policy interpretation in complex or sensitive cases. Maintain policy version control and governance documentation. 5. Management Advisory & Risk Consultation Advise Management on labor law implications of HR decisions, employee discipline and termination risks, high-risk employee relations matters, contractual risks in influencer/KOL engagements, and complex policy interpretation. Partner with Legal, Finance, HR, and business units on employment and contract-related risk matters. 6. Capability Building & Risk Awareness Conduct training on labor compliance, due process, HR governance, and contract risk awareness. Coach HR and relevant teams on compliant documentation, risk assessment, and decision-making. Scope Boundaries HR governance and compliance Employee relations and case management Labor law interpretation Contract risk review and governance Legal coordination on employment and contract matters

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Fintech Success Manager plays a dual role: Drive upsell and expansion of Fintech products across Sprout’s existing client base by aligning product activation and adoption with client goals and outcomes. This includes end-to-end ownership of ReadyCash, from opportunity creation and closing through activation and all post-activation activities. Act as the Fintech Champion and specialist for both the Sales and Upsell Teams, helping shape the fintech go-to-market strategy, cascading product and process knowledge, and leading internal enablement and field feedback. This role requires a strategic mindset and strong execution capabilities—balancing account growth responsibilities with category ownership within the Sales and Upsell Teams. Key Responsibilities Achieve and exceed assigned upsell revenue targets, with a strong focus on fintech product activation (e.g., ReadyCash, ReadyWage, ReadyStash). ● Own ReadyCash end to end: opportunity creation, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and closing, through client activation and all post-activation activities. Identify, qualify, and close account expansion opportunities, mapping Sprout’s fintech solutions to client needs and business goals. Act as the primary Fintech Champion for the Sales and Upsell Teams—maintaining deep product and process knowledge and serving as the go-to resource for fintech-related opportunities. Serve as the Fintech specialist and support for both the Sales and Upsell Teams by joining discovery calls, demos, and client meetings, answering fintech-specific questions, and handling objections on ReadyCash deals. Develop and execute upsell strategies with a client-first mindset, emphasizing business value, retention impact, and seamless product adoption. Lead fintech engagement during account reviews, lifecycle touchpoints, and proactive outreach moments. Collaborate closely with the Fintech team to align on product roadmap, GTM campaigns, and special offers, ensuring execution across the Upsell portfolio. Cascade fintech updates, launch communications, training, and best practices to Success Consultants and the Sales Team to support fintech adoption at scale. Own the end-to-end upsell process—from consultative discovery and proposal creation to commercial negotiation and deal closure. Lead ReadyCash activation for closed deals, working with Implementation and Ops to get clients set up and live. Manage all ReadyCash post-activation activities, including employee rollout and awareness, adoption and usage monitoring, issue resolution, and regular account reviews. Support clients post-activation by guiding fintech product adoption with relevant internal stakeholders (Product, Ops, Implementation). Maintain and update a clear pipeline and forecast for fintech-related opportunities using Sprout’s CRM, including ReadyCash opportunities from creation through activation. Collect and share feedback from the field to continuously improve fintech offerings, GTM strategy, and internal alignment. Deliver customized presentations and proposals that articulate value to operational and C-level decision-makers. Build strong, consultative relationships across key accounts and uncover referral and growth opportunities within client networks. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by the Fintech Director or company leadership.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Fashion Designer Job Summary: The Fashion Designer will be responsible for conceptualizing, creating, and developing fashion designs that align with the brand's aesthetic and target market. Will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Production Merchandising, Purchasing, R&D, Product and Development, Merchandising Planning and Control Departmentand Marketing, to ensure that the designs are translated into successful retail products that meet customer needs and contribute to the company's growth. Analyze and interpret trend forecasts to adapt them to the brand's design direction. Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to source necessary materials and maintain strong relationships. Prototyping and Sampling: Oversee the creation of prototypes and samples, providing guidance and feedback to ensure designs are accurately translated into physical products. Participate in fittings and adjustments to ensure the garments' fit, comfort, and overall aesthetic meet brand standards. Collection Presentation: Contribute to the development of lookbooks, presentations, and visual displays for showcasing collections to internal teams and potential buyers. Adaptation and Iteration: Continuously refine designs based on feedback, market performance, and emerging trends to enhance the brand's offerings. Technical Expertise: Stay knowledgeable about garment construction techniques, pattern making, and manufacturing processes to ensure design feasibility and efficiency. Brand Consistency: Ensure that all designs align with the brand's core values, identity, and aesthetic.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Senior Accountant — Where Precision Meets Real Impact Some accountants just keep the books. You keep them clean, compliant, and constantly getting better. We're looking for a Senior Accountant to own the balance sheet and general ledger — making sure everything ties out to US GAAP and corporate policy, while spotting the process improvements that make the whole function run leaner. If you take genuine pride in a reconciliation that balances to the cent — and can't help asking "why do we do it this way?" — keep reading. What you'll own You'll be at the heart of the financial close — preparing month-end journal entries and reconciliations, maintaining the general ledger, and keeping every financial record accurate. You'll support financial statement preparation and internal reporting, monitor and reconcile intercompany transactions, and review and validate resale certificates for tax compliance. You'll be the go-to during audits — internal and external — providing the documentation and analysis that keep things moving, and ensuring everything stays compliant with GAAP and internal policy. You'll collaborate across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Tax, and you'll never stop looking for ways to sharpen the general ledger function. And because the business is growing and changing, you'll stay adaptable — taking on new responsibilities, special projects, and stepping in wherever timely, accurate accounting is needed. You'll thrive here if you have Non-negotiables A Bachelor's degree in Accounting 5+ years' accounting experience for US-based companies A strong general accounting background — journal entries (accruals, prepayments, bank transactions), fixed asset accounting, payroll accounting, balance sheet reconciliation Comfort with 3–10 journal entries a day during month-end close Experience preparing 5–15 balance sheet reconciliations per month Solid monthly book-closing experience Experience across at least two accounting ERP systems (Oracle, NetSuite, SAP, PeopleSoft, Xero, High Radius, etc. — combinations like QuickBooks + SAP, QuickBooks + Oracle NetSuite, QuickBooks + MS Dynamics, QuickBooks + PeopleSoft, or QuickBooks + High Radius all work) Effective written and verbal communication Superb attention to detail, strong planning, and excellent organisation The flexibility to juggle shifting priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Flexible / nice to have CPA (preferred, not required) International experience — especially UK, France, and Germany — including multiple entities, foreign transactions, multiple currencies, and non-US accounting standards Oracle EBS or a similar major ERP Strong Excel skills (advanced formulas a plus) Exposure to financial system tools like Blackline, Hyperion/Smartview, Tableau Experience supporting US-based companies and applying resale tax certificates in multi-state environments The kind of person who fits Self-motivated and solutions-oriented, with high energy and a team-first attitude. Diligent about quality and reducing errors, efficient at getting things done on time, and naturally inquisitive — the type who asks the right questions to truly understand the data. You build relationships easily across teams and bring calm, organised focus to everything you touch. Why you'll love it This is accounting with room to grow. You'll own meaningful work, have real influence over how the function operates, and get the variety of a business that's evolving fast. Precision matters here — and so does the person behind it. If you're ready to bring your best numbers game to a team that values it, let's talk.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: We're looking for a Head of Growth to build, lead and continuously improve our client acquisition function. This isn't a traditional marketing role. It is best suited to a highly experienced growth operator who is strong in both strategic leadership and hands-on marketing execution. Purpose As Head of Growth, you will: Build, prove and scale a predictable, measurable client acquisition engine. Lead the Client Acquisition Team toward agreed acquisition and meeting targets. Deliver a consistent flow of qualified prospects and booked discovery meetings. Reduce reliance on the Managing Director for lead generation. Key Responsibilities Go-to-Market & Positioning Own Clear's acquisition strategy for the Australian market. Define positioning, messaging and value propositions across service lines. Conduct market and competitor research to sharpen our pitch. Test recognition-first positioning and the free Clear Work Allocation Assessment. Identify new target industries, service verticals and market opportunities. Develop quarterly and annual growth roadmaps covering acquisition priorities, campaigns and strategic initiatives. Design and optimise lead magnets, assessments, calculators, webinars and other resources that generate qualified demand. Pipeline & Acquisition Own pipeline targets and track performance against them. Sharpen Progressive Trust Prospecting through the Managing Director's LinkedIn, making it more effective and less dependent on his personal time. Propose and test additional acquisition channels using clear benchmarks and return cases before launch. Brand & Content Direct content, social and website activity to strengthen credibility and generate demand. Review output for accuracy, brand consistency and alignment with Clear's positioning. Build thought leadership through the team. Funnel, CRM & Automation Own the marketing technology stack and recommend improvements across CRM, automation, AI, reporting and analytics. Own funnel design and automation strategy, including CRM workflows, lead scoring and nurture sequences. Lead CRM use for pipeline visibility and reporting. Assess the Marketing Automation Specialist role and oversee the phased transition from GoHighLevel to the Ignite app, auditing what actually needs to move. Team Leadership & Systems Lead the Client Acquisition Team and set agreed output targets for each member. Run regular one-to-ones and performance reviews, maintaining clear accountability. Align sales development, automation and content around shared acquisition goals. Build documented systems, SOPs and repeatable processes that reduce dependency on individuals. Ensure operational work is delegated and completed through the team. Performance & Reporting Own growth reporting across lead volume and quality, discovery-meeting show rates, cost per lead, cost per client, pipeline value and revenue influenced. Report performance to the Managing Director on an agreed cadence. Test and optimise acquisition channels using data and attribution. Document learnings from experiments and use them to guide future investment. Stakeholder Alignment Work closely with the Managing Director to turn client wins, losses and objections into marketing insights. Partner with Service Delivery, Operations and Recruitment to identify client feedback, operational insights and service improvements. Feed these insights back into targeting, positioning and messaging. Take on other growth and marketing leadership priorities as required by management.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Role The Partnerships Executive is a fast-paced, revenue-driving role built for someone who knows how to hustle, network, and close deals. Your primary focus will be generating new B2B business by pitching our agency’s services to Sales and Marketing Leaders. You will also work directly with our PR Team to identify and manage strategic partnerships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). We are looking for a highly confident, target-driven professional with a polished demeanor. You will spend your time aggressively hunting for new business and securing signed contracts, as well as dedicating time to KOL coordination and PR strategy. Strategic Alliances (KOLs): Work closely as the right-hand to the PR Director to identify, recommend, and coordinate with the right KOLs and influencers for various brand campaigns. Network Expansion: Attend high-profile industry events and utilize your existing professional network to uncover new business opportunities and elevate the agency's profile. Sales Strategy & Pitching: Prepare and deliver tailored, high-impact presentations and proposals to prospective clients. Pipeline & Documentation Management: Keep a rigorous, detail-oriented track of sales performance, client feedback, and partner documentation to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Fluidly balance the demands of B2B outbound sales with the nuanced relationship management required for PR partners. *The company operates in a hybrid setup wherein majority of the work is done from home. However, Client and Partner Meetings as well as Industry and Client Events are mostly done within Metro Manila which the selected applicant will be required to attend.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Join a dynamic retail organization where your analytical skills and attention to detail will directly contribute to operational excellence and business success. As an Inventory Analyst , you will play a critical role in maintaining inventory accuracy, identifying opportunities for improvement, and providing valuable insights that support informed business decisions. Working closely with various departments, you will help ensure the integrity of inventory data, optimize inventory processes, and support efficient retail operations. Coordinate physical count activities, permits, and requirements for boutiques and department stores. Track completion status and ensure inventory count activities are executed accurately and on schedule. Inventory Analysis & Reporting Investigate, analyze, and report inventory discrepancies before and after physical counts. Prepare detailed inventory variance reports and provide insights to support corrective actions. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for inventory improvement and loss prevention. Sales & Inventory Reconciliation Process and validate weekly and monthly sales and inventory reports. Monitor inventory movements, stock balances, warehouse transactions, and clearance activities. Ensure data accuracy and consistency across inventory and sales records. Process Improvement & Operational Support Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve inventory-related issues and improve inventory accuracy. Support initiatives that enhance inventory controls, reporting processes, and operational efficiency. Provide timely and accurate inventory information to support business planning and decision-making.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary of Work Activities and Responsibilities: The Administrative Assistant for Resident Accounts and Finance Support VI provides support in ensuring the financial integrity and operational efficiency of the University Residence Halls by monitoring compliance with accounting procedures, and managing accounts payable, inventory, and financial documentation to ensure that the URH remains compliant with University and government policies. Main Duties and Responsibilities: I. Internal Controls Support Ensures accuracy of resident accounts, payables, and financial processes in support of minimizing operational risks Reviews and reconciles URH Masterlist vis-à-vis the AISIS and Central Accounting Office lodging fee records every school term, and provides recommendations for discrepancies Reviews and reconciles daily operational and financial transactions to ensure accuracy of accounting records for transient bookings and guest transactions Reviews documents for cash advances, reimbursements, refunds, petty cash replenishments, liquidations, and URH payments Assists in the evaluation of the economy, efficiency, and effectiveness of operations by providing data and inputs to support management review Checks and monitors the compliance of transactions with University policies and recommends corrective/ preventive measures based on findings Assists in the review of policies, procedures, and internal control systems to ensure compliance with University policies Assists the Director in reviewing policies and processes to ensure alignment with University policies and government laws and regulations ​​​​​​​ II. Accounting, Compliance, and Financial Management Assists in reviewing fiscal policies and procedures, collection data, and billing information to support compliance with accounting and University standards, and coordinates with concerned offices Reviews budget vis-à-vis actual expenditures of the Ateneo Resident Students Association, and raises any concerns or variances to designated representatives III. Accounts Payable Management Serves as the Unit’s Reviewer/Approver I for the CAO Payment System and Electronic Purchase Requisitions by reviewing vendor invoices and payment/purchase orders prior to the approval of the Director Maintains proper documentation to support audit and compliance requirements IV. Inventory Management Maintains accurate asset and inventory registers, including acquisition dates, costs, and depreciation schedules Monitors and reconciles inventory balances by tracking, verifying, and conducting periodic reviews to prevent loss or discrepancies Coordinates with the CAO and Central Purchasing Office in monitoring and reporting asset values, and in calculating and ensuring proper application of depreciation and inventory policies ​​​​​​​ V. Office Management Support Attends to visitors and screens relevant inquiries and requests received through various communication channels Drafts letters, memoranda, and other communications related to URH financial matters Coordinates with designated personnel and supports in the planning and implementation of URH-initiated and University-wide events and programs VI. Performs other duties as may be required by the immediate supervisor or authorized representatives

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Role Overview We are looking for an Office Manager to run Moongig's Makati office at Century Diamond Tower. This is a hands-on admin and operations role: suppliers managed, supplies stocked, invoices received and issued on time, and a workplace that just works. You will own the day-to-day: supplier relationships, office spend, invoice intake and issuance, building coordination, permits and renewals, and admin support to the back-office team. You will work closely with Finance and HR, and directly with the founders. Good fit if you follow through without being chased and notice what needs doing before someone asks. If you want a defined admin role with a fixed checklist, this is not it. deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Assistant Merchandising and Control Manager supports the planning, coordination, monitoring, and execution of merchandise planning and control activities for Gingersnaps and Just G brands. The role assists in sales analysis, forecasting, inventory management, markdowns, replenishment, allocation, reporting, and inventory productivity while ensuring accurate and timely completion of operational requirements. It also coordinates with cross-functional teams such as Ecommerce, Warehouse, Creatives, Production, Store Operations, and Marketing to ensure smooth execution of merchandise plans, inventory activities, and seasonal launches. Duties and Responsibilities: Merchandise Planning Coordination Support execution and monitoring of category planning, assortment planning, and merchandise allocation activities. Coordinate planning timelines, report submissions, and merchandise calendar deliverables. Monitor implementation progress of approved merchandise planning strategies and inventory actions. Ensure alignment of merchandise execution activities with approved seasonal plans and launch schedules. Sales & Inventory Monitoring Oversee preparation and validation of sales dashboards, category reports, sell-through analysis, Months-to-Sell (MTS) reports, and inventory monitoring reports. Review sales and inventory trends, inventory risks, and stock movement concerns. Escalate key inventory and merchandise performance concerns to the MPCD Manager. Monitor inventory productivity and sell-through performance across channels and categories. Forecasting & Allocation Support Support forecasting reviews, allocation planning coordination, and replenishment execution. Ensure inventory allocation activities are aligned with approved category plans and inventory priorities. Monitor allocation accuracy and inventory balancing activities across channels. Coordinate inventory movement and replenishment activities with Warehouse and Store Operations teams. Markdown & Inventory Productivity Execution Coordinate markdown implementation schedules and monitor markdown execution progress. Review markdown files, inventory aging reports, and sell-through trends prior to implementation. Monitor inventory productivity initiatives including replenishment, pullouts, consolidation, promotion and markdown execution. Ensure timely implementation of approved markdown and inventory-related activities. Report Governance & Validation Ensure timely and accurate completion of Merchandising and Control reports, planning tools, and merchandise analysis deliverables. Review report accuracy, data completeness, and compliance with reporting standards. Maintain reporting governance and submission discipline across the department calendar. Support management presentations and report consolidation requirements. Team Coordination & Operational Supervision Provide day-to-day guidance and operational supervision to the Category Analyst and Merchandising Assistant. Monitor task execution, timelines, and operational deliverables of the MPCD team. Coordinate cross-functional follow-ups related to inventory, launches, markdowns, promotions, and merchandise operational concerns. Support implementation of process improvements and operational discipline within the department.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: I. General Description of the Position The UI/UX designer focuses on creating user-friendly and visually appealing digital products by designing both the user interface (UI) and the overall user experience (UX) UI/UX Designer responsibilities include gathering user requirements, designing graphic elements and building navigation components. To be successful, he/she must have experience with design software and wireframe tools, both in web and mobile applications. Ultimately, he/she creates both functional and appealing features that address our clients’ needs and help us grow our customer base. II. Summary of Responsibilities As a Jr. UI/UX Designer , he/she is expected to perform the following duties; Gathers and evaluates user requirements in collaboration with product managers and engineers Illustrates design ideas using storyboards, process flows, and sitemaps Develops user flows to map out the step-by-step journey users take within a product Writes user stories that define user goals, needs, and pain points Collaborates with product managers to align user flows with business objectives Designs graphic user interface elements, like menus, tabs, and widgets Builds page navigation buttons and search fields Develops UI mockups and prototypes that clearly illustrate how sites function and look Develops intuitive, usable, and engaging interactions and visual designs for mobile. Creates original graphic designs (e.g., images, sketches, and tables) Prepares and presents rough drafts to internal teams and key stakeholders Identifies and troubleshoots UX problems (e.g., responsiveness) Conducts layout adjustments based on user feedback Adheres to style standards on typography, colors, and images Collaborates with cross-functional teams throughout the design process Participates in the development process from definition, through design, build, test, release, and maintenance. Stay abreast of UX trends and look for creative ideas and inspiration in parallel, analogous worlds. Researches and tracks advancements in web and mobile application design patterns. Breaks any design problem down into viable, actionable chunks and solves them with clarity and precision. Stays in the loop and on top of the latest standards, changes, and trends in the web and mobile design field. Utilizes AI-powered design and productivity tools responsibly to improve workflow efficiency, ideation, research, content generation, wireframing, and design exploration Reviews, validates, and refines AI-generated outputs to ensure originality, usability, brand alignment, and business relevance Applies critical thinking when using AI-assisted workflows and avoids overreliance on generated solutions Documents and communicates AI-assisted processes transparently when applicable Continuously explores emerging AI tools, automation workflows, and best practices relevant to UI/UX design and product development Reports to the Chief Innovations Officer and/or Business Unit Head.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Role in a Nutshell As a Member Success Intern at Strong Pilates Philippines, you help make sure every member gets what they came for: a routine they keep, results they can feel, and a studio that feels like theirs. You support the Member Success team across inquiries, follow-ups, and community initiatives, while learning how a boutique fitness business converts, retains, and grows its members. This is a hands-on, paid internship built as a path to a full-time role. You will work with real members, real leads, and real events, not busywork. We are not hiring someone to fill in for a few months. We are hiring the person we hope becomes our next full-time Member Success Associate. Internship Details Paid internship, with the opportunity for full-time employment Schedule: Flexible and inquiry-driven. You respond to member inquiries and touchpoints as they come in, and join in-studio for events and initiatives as needed Duration: 3 months, with the possibility of extending to 6 months, leading to a full-time Member Success Associate role Location: Hybrid. Inquiries are handled remotely, with in-studio presence for member touchpoints and events Reports to: Member Success Lead What You’ll Do Member Support and Sales: Respond to email, social media, and in-studio inquiries promptly and on brand, escalating anything outside your scope. Follow up with leads and trial clients, guiding them toward the membership or package that fits their goals. Perform touchpoints with new and recurring members, such as first-class check-ins, milestone messages, and re-engagement of lapsed members, documenting their needs and preferences in the CRM. Help keep the sales pipeline clean and current, from first inquiry through follow-up and after-sales. Assist in tracking and following up on failed payments. Support CRM-driven campaigns for lead nurturing, retention, and win-back. Help prepare weekly reports on leads, conversions, and retention. Community and Member Experience: Help plan and run member initiatives and events, from preparation and setup to documentation and follow-up. Support our referral, loyalty, and ambassador programs. Collect and organize member feedback, and flag recurring patterns to the team. Assist with retention initiatives such as Strong Human of the Month. Contribute ideas to improve our workflows, SOPs, and overall member experience. Other Key Responsibilities Take pride in Strong Pilates Philippines studio/s as if they were your own. Be a proud and visible ambassador for Strong Pilates Philippines, on- and off-site. Contribute to nurturing the sense of community within Strong Pilates Philippines. Learn our CRM and booking systems, sales approach, and brand standards, and apply them consistently. Ensure compliance with data privacy laws and company standards in handling member information. What You’ll Gain Paid internship, with compensation discussed during the interview Hands-on training in sales, CRM, and member experience in boutique fitness Mentorship from the Member Success team, with exposure to the founders Complimentary studio access across Strong and Perigon Certificate of completion, with hours creditable toward school requirements Consideration for a full-time Member Success Associate role, based on performance We expect your dedication and passion to be exclusive to Strong Pilates Philippines and its affiliated lifestyle brand, Perigon Rhythmic Cycling. School requirements are understood, but concurrent internships, part-time roles, freelance clients, or outside retainers are not compatible with this position.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Main Area of Responsibility: As an AI/ML Engineer, you will help design, build, and deploy intelligent systems and AI agents that power next-generation experiences across our products. You will work closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to implement agentic workflows, orchestration pipelines, and model integrations using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and other emerging AI toolkits. Your role will involve developing AI agents, API wrappers, and microservices that connect various systems, enabling contextual reasoning and automation. You will also assist in fine-tuning and deploying machine learning or foundation models where applicable and ensure that AI components are reliable, scalable, and aligned with responsible AI principles. The AI Chapter owns all AI-specific deployment, observability, and lifecycle operations, and as part of this team, you will support efforts to maintain these pipelines, modernize APIs for AI consumption, and, where required, help implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar interoperability layers to enhance agent-to-system communication. Implement and maintain AI workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar, enabling tool use, memory, and contextual understanding. Integrate agents with internal and external APIs, databases, and third-party tools to enable intelligent automation and information retrieval. Assist in the development and maintenance of API wrappers or connectors that allow agents to interact with enterprise systems and external services. Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to modernize and document APIs, ensuring they are optimized for AI agent interoperability, observability, and security. Support the design or implementation of Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards to facilitate seamless interaction between agents and systems. Fine-tune or adapt custom ML or foundation models for specific use cases and deploy them as part of the agentic pipeline when necessary. Support AI-centric DevOps and MLOps workflows, including CI/CD for model services, environment configuration, versioning, and telemetry integration. Participate in the monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement of deployed AI systems through feedback loops and observability metrics. Follow responsible AI guidelines, ensuring fairness, transparency, explainability, and safety in all implementations. Collaborate with senior engineers to document designs, improve internal AI frameworks, and maintain clean, production-ready codebases.

We’re passionate about building scalable systems, delivering exceptional service, and growing together as a team. You will serve as a go-to expert for HubSpot and marketing operations, driving automation, analytics, content development workflows, and cross-functional process optimization with both strategic and hands-on contributions. The ideal candidate is a proactive selfstarter with a collaborative mindset and a strong desire to contribute to a positive, highperformance culture. Maintain and improve the MarTech stack; ensure system reliability, data cleanliness, documentation, and scalability. Build, launch, and optimize multi-channel digital campaigns across social, search, and email. Develop cost-efficient, high-ROI marketing engines for internal teams and external clients. Create playbooks, QA processes, SLAs, and workflow standards to improve operational efficiency. Gather, analyze, and report on KPIs (UTMs, attribution, funnel metrics, conversion rates). Present insights and optimization recommendations to leadership and client stakeholders. Coordinate briefs, assets, calendars, and deliverables with cross-functional teams. Mentor junior contributors and support a collaborative, high-performance culture with a path toward supervisory/player-coach responsibilities. How to Apply Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and any relevant certifications or work samples.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The front-end developer creates interaction and user experience with scripts embedded in a site’s HTML. Everything a visitor to a site sees, clicks, or uses to input or retrieve information is the work of the front-end developer who creates client-side software that brings the site’s design to life. Using a combination of markup languages, design, and client-side scripts and frameworks, the front-end developer creates the environment for everything that website users see and touch: content, layout, and interaction. He/she must be willing to work in a fast-paced, professional, deadline-driven environment; be knowledgeable in web development standards; and must be able to communicate with project stakeholders effectively. Responsibilities include Convert approved designs in any format (e.g. PSD)  into interactive web pages using HTML, CSS, and Javascript. Create and edit standards-compliant Wordpress themes. Create custom Wordpress page templates. Set up animations and videos on web pages using HTML5. Add and update site content. Ensure site compatibility across required browsers. Learn new coding techniques and platforms with minimal supervision Review and prioritize queued tasks. Coordinate with team leader, project manager, and art director about deliverables. Provide clear concise task updates to project managers and art directors to facilitate a smooth workflow within the team. Comply with company policies as stated in the handbook provided upon employment. Must pass the FEWD nesting exam. Would need to complete 4 type-1 conversions or 2 for other types per month (3% of average monthly incoming conversions). Would need a minimum QA score of 95% per month consecutive for 4 months. Must undergo and pass WCAG and ADA training. Must undergo and pass Bootstrap training. Key Competencies Resourcefulness Creativity Must be coachable and willing to adapt to changes Ability to work under minimal supervision Ability to clearly express ideas and solutions to team mates and stakeholders

Coordinate renewal of business permits and monitor and process payment for business and real property taxes Assist in handling BIR/BOC examinations and other projects Assist during annual audit of financial statements

nama_pekerjaan: Student Records Assistant for Document Processing
deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary of Work Activities and Responsibilities: The Student Records Assistant for Document Processing III reports to the Assistant Registrar for Document Services. A key deliverable of the Registrar’s Office is the generation of documents. These documents attest to the academic performance of the student. Therefore, it is essential that a competent full-time employee be hired to facilitate the processing, correctness, and promptness of the documents prepared by the Registrar’s Office. Main Duties and Responsibilities: I. Frontline Support Attends to inquiries, requests for documents, verification of records for various types of documents such as Transcript of Records, Certifications, Diploma, etc. at the counter and through email Logs requests received from students made over the counter or via email, and monitors online payments for document requests on a daily basis Assists in the processing and checking of documents requests for both undergraduate and graduate students and in timely release of such documents Coordinates with the Document Officers and ARDS for all mailing requests and ensures that all documents are mailed via courier accurately and on time. Assists in sending out requests for verification of academic records in coordination with the Records and Document Officers Provides input in developing an effective and systematic process for receiving, preparing, and retrieving scholastic documents and files in line with office standards of relevance, efficiency, and service Ensures proper records keeping and disposal of files, and maintains proper upkeep of the reception area II. Documents and Records Management Support Coordinates with Documents and Records personnel in determining students’ eligibility for issuance of official documents (Transcript of records, diploma, Transfer Credentials and certifications) by checking their clearance, hold orders from different departments, and other similar pre-requisite records Partners with Document Officers regarding email replies to verification requests Serves as frontliner maintaining a general knowledge of the functions of other sections of the Registrar’s Office which in turn develops capacity to assist when the need arises Distributes Transcripts of Records, verification forms/letters through the official courier Prepares and monitors documents to be mailed and coordinates with the official courier to schedule daily pick-up of documents and payment of mailing fees Receives and logs complete admission documents of new students received from the Office of the Associate Dean for Graduate Programs Assists in handling requests for Certification, Authentication, and Verification (CAV) by preparing documents such as transcripts of records, diplomas and certifications to be transmitted to the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) and Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) III. Performs other work-related tasks as may be required by the immediate supervisor and any authorized representative

Eskwelabs instructors define the learning journey and help learners build strong foundations before diving into applied practice. Guide learners as they build AI-enabled workflows and application features using Microsoft technologies. Coach learners through developing a working prototype based on a real business use case. Help learners troubleshoot technical and implementation challenges during development. Provide actionable feedback as learners test, evaluate, and improve their AI solutions. Translate real industry practice into teachable frameworks and workflows. Reinforce understanding with examples, diagnostics, and actionable feedback. Create all materials from scratch (Eskwelabs provides core materials and support). Do homework outside designated class commitments. Attend on-site sessions unless you opt in. Collaborate with experienced educators and industry practitioners. Contribute to meaningful learning experiences that create real impact. deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary of Work Activities and Responsibilities: The Data and Systems Head provides leadership in the strategic direction, governance, management, and continuous enhancement of OUDAA's advancement information, reporting, and analytics capabilities to support donor development, alumni engagement, fundraising, resource mobilization, institutional reporting, and data-informed decision-making. The position serves as OUDAA's lead steward for advancement information and analytics, ensuring the quality, integrity, confidentiality, availability, and responsible use of advancement information. It likewise champions the effective use of information and a culture of data-informed decision-making across OUDAA. Main Duties and Responsibilities I. Advancement Information Planning and Strategic Oversight Provides and oversees implementation of strategic direction for the continuous enhancement of OUDAA’s advancement information, reporting, and analytics capabilities. Aligns and defines advancement information, reporting, and analytics priorities and requirements in support of donor development, alumni engagement, fundraising, stewardship, resource mobilization, institutional reporting, and decision-making. Anticipates emerging information needs and evolving institutional requirements that may affect advancement information, reporting, analytics, and decision-support priorities. Develops and monitors indicators for information quality, reporting effectiveness, and analytics usefulness. II. Advancement Information Governance and Stewardship Provides direction on governance standards for advancement information and related data systems. Provides governance oversight of advancement information assets and supporting data systems. Exercises stewardship over sensitive and strategically significant advancement information. III. Advancement Information Management Oversees the management of OUDAA’s advancement information assets and authoritative information sources. Directs the continuous improvement of advancement information management processes. IV. Advancement Intelligence, Reporting, and Decision Support Oversees the generation and effective use of advancement intelligence, reporting, and analytics. Strengthens institutional visibility, planning, advancement coordination, and resource mobilization efforts through reliable reporting and analytics. Directs the continuous enhancement of reporting and analytics capabilities. V. Information Partnership and Data-Informed Decision Support Serves as an internal advisor on advancement information, reporting, analytics, and information management matters. Promotes alignment and collaboration on advancement information priorities. Champions a culture of data-informed decision-making across OUDAA. VI. Section Leadership and Management Coordinates with the rest of the leadership team of OUDAA and sets strategic direction and performance standards for the Advancement Information and Analytics Management Section. Assesses overall Section performance. Evaluates the Section’s current and future workforce requirements in relation to strategic and program needs, and guides workforce planning through capability development, succession planning, strategic deployment, and hiring recommendations to ensure sustained readiness. Ensures effective stewardship of Section resources. Leads staff development and engagement. VII. Performs other work-related tasks as may be required by the immediate supervisor and authorized representative.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Why Join the Mentor Pool? We're building a community of industry practitioners who are passionate about helping others grow. As an Eskwelabs Mentor, you'll guide learners as they apply real-world concepts through hands-on projects, coaching, and feedback in our part-time learning programs. Joining the Mentor Pool gives you access to recurring mentorship opportunities across Eskwelabs' learning programs. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in projects based on their expertise, availability, and program needs. About the Role What You'll Teach You will guide learners through crafting a clear Product Vision & Strategy to align engineering, design, and business goals. You will teach learners how to apply frameworks like RICE, MoSCoW, and the Kano model for effective Prioritization techniques. You will coach learners on mapping out comprehensive and actionable Product Roadmaps. You will explain principles of User-Centered Design and help learners conduct rigorous User Research. You will facilitate sessions on designing an impactful User Journey Design. You will lead learners in adopting and executing Agile Methodologies within product development cycles. You will guide learners in setting up growth loops, A/B testing, and experimentation to drive product growth. You will demonstrate effective end-to-end Product Lifecycle Management practices. Sample Learning Sprint You will coach learners by answering questions and guiding project execution during their practical workshops. You will encourage learner confidence, persistence, and collaboration within the group's learning environment. You will provide practical feedback to support learner progress and milestone performance throughout the sprint. You will review learner-submitted work during the week to call out strengths and suggest actionable improvements. What we're looking for We're looking for industry practitioners who enjoy sharing their expertise and helping others learn. Professional teaching experience is welcome but not required. We value real-world experience, curiosity, and a willingness to coach others. What you'll do Coach learners through hands-on projects. Provide timely, actionable feedback. Answer learner questions and unblock challenges. Share industry best practices and encourage collaboration. What you won't do You will not be expected to: Create learning materials from scratch. Deliver full lectures or develop curriculum. Complete work outside agreed mentorship commitments. Participate in on-site sessions unless you choose to join projects that require them. What you'll gain Earn through flexible paid mentorship opportunities. Develop your coaching and leadership skills. Collaborate with experienced educators and practitioners. Access Eskwelabs learning resources and professional development. Work Arrangement Project assignments may be conducted remotely, onsite, or in a hybrid setup depending on the needs of each learning program. How to Apply Applications for this role are managed through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form. Click Apply to be redirected to our official application portal. As part of the application process, you will be asked to: Complete a short application form Upload your resume Share your professional background and mentoring experience Choose your preferred assessment pathway (Fireside Chat or Video Submission) Only applications submitted through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form will be reviewed.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: ABOUT US We are looking for individuals who can evangelize the idea that productive work can be done from anywhere! Right now businesses are spending billions on larger than necessary workspaces. The pandemic has forced businesses to consider work-from-home arrangements, but businesses are struggling to see this as a sustainable and productive way to move forward. Squadzip is the Digital Extension of the Office, a platform that serves as a central reporting hub for all types of customer interactions, face-to-face interactions, video calls, voice calls, messaging, and more. We are looking for a few, energetic, driven individuals to help us spread this movement across the world. We're building a reliable, secure, and scalable DevOps infrastructure to support our growing applications. Our team focuses on automation, cloud efficiency, and security best practices while ensuring smooth deployments and system reliability. We run on AWS, Docker, and CI/CD automation, and we're continuously improving our cloud infrastructure, security, and database performance. THE ROLE This is an AWS infrastructure and operations focused DevOps role. The position focuses on AWS cloud infrastructure, system reliability, monitoring, and security operations. While some scripting and automation is required, this is NOT a software development role . If you love optimizing cloud environments, automating workflows, and implementing security best practices, we’d love to have you onboard! Responsibilities: AWS Infrastructure & Security - Follow AWS Well-Architected - learn, measure, and build using architectural best practices. - Design, deploy, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure (Fargate, ECS, ECR, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch and others). - Implement IAM best practices, access control, and security logging. - Monitor system logs, security alerts, and cloud compliance tools to maintain a secure environment. - Research current and existing technologies for potential use. - Help troubleshoot and fix problems in production. - Strong interest in Linux system administration, cloud infrastructure operations, and production system reliability. Containerization & CI/CD - Manage Docker containers and optimize AWS Fargate workloads. - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeCommit. - Conduct security scanning (e.g., Trivy, AWS Inspector) on container images. PostgreSQL & Database Operations - Deploy and maintain automated backups. - Configure connection pooling and security. - Implement PostgreSQL read replicas for scaling. - Monitor database performance and ensure secure database configurations. Security & Monitoring - Maintain AWS Security best practices, including encryption, logging, and monitoring. - Implement network security controls (VPC, security groups, firewall rules). - Automate security checks and proactively identify vulnerabilities in cloud workloads. Nice-to-Have Skills (Big Plus, but Not Required): - Familiarity with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Memcached. - Experience with AWS WAF, GuardDuty, or security auditing tools. - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience with CloudFormation. - Knowledge of Redis & Memcached performance tuning. - Scripting experience in Bash, Python, or Ruby. - New Relic - Gitlab - Fastlane - Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile (Android and iOS) - Familiarity with Automated Testing Why Join Us? - Work with a cloud-first DevOps team focused on security & automation. - Solve AWS scaling and deployment challenges. - Opportunities to grow in DevOps, security, and cloud architecture.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Purpose: The Project Controller - Global Resource Manager (GDCP) oversees resource utilization, project controlling functions, and the efficient allocation of billable hours across global teams. Additionally, this role includes leading and mentoring junior team members, ensuring alignment with PMO goals and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will have expertise in resource management, project financials, and team leadership to drive productivity and success. Area of Responsibility: A. Resource Utilization & Workforce Planning Manage and track utilization rates, ensuring optimal distribution of billable hours. Forecast resource demand based on project pipeline and business needs. Collaborate with project managers and department heads to ensure efficient resource allocation. Develop strategies to balance workloads, reduce underutilization, and improve efficiency. B. Project Controlling & Financial Oversight Support project financial planning by monitoring billable hours, costs, and budgets. Analyze financial data and resource performance, providing insights for decision-making. Ensure compliance with financial policies and project governance frameworks. Identify optimization opportunities to enhance financial and operational efficiency. C. Missing for Project Controlling: Monitor and analyze project costs through detailed plan vs. actual comparisons Support financial project planning and budgeting in collaboration with project managers. Develop and update project forecasts for costs, revenues, margins, and resource needs. Conduct variance and profitability analyses, identifying root causes and proposing corrective actions. Apply methods such as Earned Value Management (EVM) to assess project performance and progress. Maintain and enhance controlling dashboards and KPIs to support early risk detection and proactive project steering. Prepare and deliver regular project and financial reports for management. D. Leadership & Team Management Lead, mentor, and supervise junior team members, to provide guidance on best practices. Delegate tasks effectively, ensuring junior team members contribute to resource management functions. Foster professional development and provide training to enhance team skills and capabilities. Act as a liaison between project teams and PMO, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration. E. Process Improvement & Reporting Implement tools, processes, and dashboards for efficient tracking of resource utilization and project financials. Prepare comprehensive reports on resource performance, financial metrics, and workforce trends for senior leadership. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, refining resource management operations for maximum efficiency.

You will collaborate with Product Owners, System Analysts, QA teams, and other technical stakeholders in an Agile environment while contributing to technical decisions, code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications. Collaborate with Product Owners, System Analysts, QA teams, and other technical stakeholders to deliver solutions and resolve complex technical issues. Identify technical risks and dependencies, take ownership of issues, and proactively contribute to application reliability and maintainability.

Ad-Hoc Projects: Support additional CX initiatives as requested by leadership.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Cloud Security Project Engineer (Client-Facing Professional Services) About the Role We are looking for a Cloud Security Project Engineer to join our team and support cloud security implementations for enterprise customers in the Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) region. We are looking for someone with a strong background in networking, cloud security, firewalls, proxies, or security technologies who is also comfortable communicating with customers and managing multiple projects. Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, traffic steering, PAC file, SSL inspection, and security policy issues. Coordinate with Sales, Support, Engineering, Professional Services, and Partners to keep projects moving. Track project activities, timelines, milestones, and technical deliverables. Coordinate with global teams when additional technical support is required. Help identify improvements to technical implementation and customer delivery processes. Maintain a professional and customer-focused approach when representing the company. Follow established security, implementation, and project delivery processes.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Company Description Agent Image is a premier, privately held Web Design and Internet Marketing solutions company focusing on products and services for real estate professionals throughout the world. Agent Image’s organizational culture is considered one of its keys to success and can be described as open, fast paced, casual and accountable (we expect all team members to perform at a high level). Job Description: Agent Image’s VIP Web Consultant is responsible for providing support to any Agent Image VIP clients and/or potential VIP clients through various channels such as phone call, email and/or slack. A VIP Web Consultant is also responsible for handling VIP clients that purchase AgentPro, Semi-Custom, ImagineStudio and True Custom website products. A VIP Web Consultant should be able to handle customer inquiries and requests in a timely manner, identify the problems and offer solutions and recommendations that will improve clients’ websites. Additionally, a VIP Web Consultant must possess great interpersonal communication skills to better convey client requests to Agent Image’s production team. Job Responsibilities: Assist our clients through the website production process until their website is launched. Act as the bridge between our clients and the production team. Ensure the project remains within scope. Report the progress of projects to clients on a regular basis. Try to keep the project timeline within the approved schedule. Proactively make suggestions to clients on how to improve their online presence through industry best practices. Must maintain excellent customer relationships. Assist in tracking web project issues and drive their resolution. Create project status reports and deliver status updates to clients and managers. Coordinate with our Los Angeles office by phone & email. Anticipate errors in the projects prior to clients calling customer support or sales. Successful launch of projects with little to no tweaks from Quality Assurance. Be proactive in reviewing the websites for possible issues and revisions. Constantly answer phone calls to support Agent Image VIP clients and provide quality customer service and web consultations. Properly document customer’s request and issue related to any company product and services through different channels such as phone call, email and chat. Can identify issues, needs and requirements of customers and record it via case on company’s internal management system and handle it in a timely manner. Ability to utilize any internal and external resources to provide resolution and/or suggestions to enhance a client's website. Setting client’s expectations for turnaround time of services provided. Report or escalate issues to the production team and efficiently follow up on tasks to meet deadlines ensuring completion of due dates and cases. Establishes and maintains rapport with existing and potential clients to effectively promote product solutions based on client needs and budget. Must be well-organized, self-directed and able to multitask, understanding the importance of detailed professional-quality work. Meet the team metrics set by the Management Can adapt to sudden changes implemented by management. Share any information on how to handle unfamiliar or difficult customer concerns for the team’s efficient performance. Customer service driven. Understands and follows company processes and policies.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Why Join the Mentor Pool? We're building a community of industry practitioners who are passionate about helping others grow. As an Eskwelabs Mentor, you'll guide learners as they apply real-world concepts through hands-on projects, coaching, and feedback in our part-time learning programs. Joining the Mentor Pool gives you access to recurring mentorship opportunities across Eskwelabs' learning programs. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in projects based on their expertise, availability, and program needs. About the Role What we're looking for We're looking for professionals who enjoy sharing their expertise and helping others learn. You don't need to be a professional educator. Many of our mentors come directly from industry and bring valuable real-world experience into the classroom. If you're passionate about coaching others and continuously learning yourself, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll do Coach learners as they work through hands-on projects and practical activities. Answer learner questions and help unblock technical or strategic challenges. Provide constructive, actionable feedback that supports learner growth. Encourage collaboration, confidence, and a positive learning experience. Share industry insights and real-world best practices. What you won't do We recognize that our mentors are busy professionals, so we've designed the role to fit alongside your existing commitments. You will not be expected to: Create learning materials from scratch. Deliver full lectures or develop curriculum. Complete work outside agreed mentorship commitments. Participate in on-site sessions unless you choose to join projects that require them. What you'll gain Inspire professionals as they build practical, future-ready skills. Develop your leadership, coaching, and mentoring abilities. Collaborate with experienced educators and industry practitioners. Access Eskwelabs learning materials and professional development resources. Enjoy flexible project-based engagements that fit alongside your career. Earn additional income through paid mentorship opportunities. Work Arrangement Project assignments may be conducted remotely, onsite, or in a hybrid setup depending on the needs of each learning program. How to Apply Applications for this role are managed through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form. Click Apply to be redirected to our official application portal. As part of the application process, you will be asked to: Complete a short application form Upload your resume Share your professional background and mentoring experience Choose your preferred assessment pathway (Fireside Chat or Video Submission) Only applications submitted through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form will be reviewed.

We are in need of a Junior Programmer to help in the development of our homegrown technology, Cast. Cast is a learning management system used by multiple institutions to scale and deliver learning online. Think of it as a system that allows users to build their own "Netflix for learning". Our team is one of the few development houses in the country that have won educational technology awards abroad. We are looking for individuals who seek challenges and aspire to change the Philippine e-learning landscape by helping organizations build their training materials for the future and build software products that can help educators all over the country. We are a remote-first company, so you will work from home most of the time. From time to time, the team meets at our Quezon City office for activities such as Build Days, planning, or collaborative problem-solving. Purpose: To help implement our two services that assist our customers build and design the future of learning for their companies: Cast, a learning management system used by multiple institutions to scale and deliver learning online Customized e-learning content creation that allows companies to build tailor-fit content that handles their unique and proprietary training needs. Responsibilities: Create UI/UX design work for product features and improvements for responsive web applications. Contribute to building and maintaining the design system and other related UI/UX documentations. Assist with user research, synthesis, and documentation. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Operations teams.

Strong technical selling capability with negotiation skills and commercial acumen. Customer-focused, results-oriented, and able to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams. Proficient in MS Office and CRM tools (Salesforce preferred); AutoCAD/Visio viewing capability is an advantage.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Nurse Navigator is a registered nurse who serves as the central point of contact for patients and families moving through the care continuum. The Navigator identifies and removes clinical, financial, logistical, and psychosocial barriers to timely care; coordinates appointments, testing, and referrals across providers and settings; and provides education and support from initial contact through treatment and follow-up. Working within a multidisciplinary team, the Navigator promotes continuity of care, improves patient understanding of the treatment plan, supports adherence, and contributes to reduced avoidable emergency department visits and readmissions. The role blends direct patient interaction, care coordination, and program-level quality work. Patient Navigation and Care Coordination Serve as the consistent, identified point of contact for assigned patients and their caregivers across the episode of care. Conduct initial and ongoing assessments to identify clinical, financial, transportation, language, health literacy, cultural, and psychosocial barriers to care. Track pending results and outstanding orders; ensure findings are communicated to the ordering provider and, as appropriate, to the patient. Patient Education and Support Provide evidence-based education on diagnosis, treatment options, medications, self-management, symptom monitoring, and warning signs requiring escalation. Deliver education at an appropriate health literacy level and in the patient's preferred language, using interpreter services when needed. Support shared decision-making by helping patients formulate questions, understand options, and communicate their goals and preferences to the care team. Provide emotional support and reinforce coping strategies; recognize distress and refer to social work, behavioral health, chaplaincy, or community resources. Connect patients to financial counseling, insurance and prior authorization assistance, prescription assistance programs, transportation, nutrition support, and other community resources. Educate patients on advance care planning and advance directives where appropriate. Documentation, Quality, and Program Development Document all navigation activities, assessments, interventions, communications, and outcomes accurately and timely in the electronic health record. Collect and report navigation metrics — for example, time to treatment, barriers identified and resolved, no-show rates, patient volume, and patient satisfaction. Participate in quality improvement initiatives, process improvement projects, and accreditation or certification survey readiness. Contribute to the development of navigation protocols, pathways, patient education materials, and standard work. Participate in community outreach, screening events, and education programs as assigned.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Medical Billing & AR Specialist will manage and support the clinic’s end-to-end medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) processes. The role will focus on claims processing, EOB review, payment posting, insurance follow-ups, denial and rejection management, and accounts receivable (AR) management. The specialist will monitor outstanding accounts, follow up on unpaid claims, identify payment issues, and help ensure timely and accurate reimbursement. The ideal candidate has strong experience in U.S. medical billing, insurance claims, EOBs, payment posting, and AR follow-up, with eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience preferred. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end medical billing and RCM activities. Submit and monitor U.S. healthcare insurance claims. Review claims for completeness and accuracy before submission. Monitor outstanding and aging accounts receivable, particularly 90+ and 120+ day AR. Follow up on unpaid, delayed, denied, and underpaid insurance claims. Review EOBs (Explanation of Benefits) and identify payment, adjustment, denial, and patient responsibility issues. Post insurance payments, adjustments, and patient balances accurately and on time. Reconcile payments and account balances. Identify and resolve claim denials, rejections, and billing issues. Submit and follow up on appeals when needed. Contact insurance payers through payer portals, phone, or other available channels to check claim status and resolve issues. Maintain accurate and updated account and claim information. Monitor AR aging and take appropriate action to reduce outstanding balances. Track claims, payments, denials, and unresolved accounts. Prepare regular reports on AR aging, claims status, payments, denials, and collections. Complete assigned billing, payment posting, and follow-up tasks within agreed SLAs. Maintain confidentiality when handling patient and healthcare information. Identify recurring billing and RCM issues and recommend process improvements. Work independently while coordinating with the clinic team and other relevant stakeholders.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Solutions Designer serves as the overall technical lead for assigned projects. This role is responsible for translating high-level architectural designs into detailed technical solutions, leading the technical implementation, and ensuring end-to-end system integration and delivery that meets business and operational requirements. Leads the creation of the Solution Plan (SP) based on the High-Level Solution (HLS) provided by the Solution Architect. Collaborates with the System Analyst to break down the HLS into actionable technical packages across applications and components. Works closely with the Project Manager (PM) and Business Analyst (BA) to refine and validate business and technical requirements. Reviews and validates the Detailed Functional Specification (DFS) with the System Analyst to ensure alignment with the planned solution. Coordinates with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Network Engineers, and Security teams to ensure holistic and secure end-to-end system design. Oversees the setup of testing and production environments in collaboration with System Administrators and Database Administrators through the System Analyst. Supports the Systems Analyst during the production handover process. Leads technical readiness activities, ensuring support teams are prepared to manage the system post-deployment. Oversees cutover planning and execution for deploying system enhancements into production. Provides technical leadership during the stabilization period after deployment, managing escalations and production issues. Partners with the PM and Service Management team to monitor system performance and assist with project closeout and knowledge transfer.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Accounting Associate will support various finance and accounting operations within the organization. Depending on assessment and business needs, the selected candidate may be assigned to functions such as Accounts Payable, Procure-to-Pay, General Accounting, Reporting, or other finance-related areas. This role requires accuracy, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate with different teams to ensure smooth financial processes. Your Roles and Responsibilities Perform accounting transactions such as invoice processing, journal entries, purchase order creation, vendor or account reconciliation, and payment processing. Ensure accuracy, compliance with company policies, and adherence to accounting standards and internal controls. Monitor open items, investigate and resolve discrepancies in financial records (e.g., between Purchase Orders, receipts, invoices, or system entries). Support vendor or customer account maintenance, documentation, and communication as needed. Assist in preparing financial reports, schedules, or analysis for internal stakeholders and audits. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (procurement, operations, finance) to resolve issues and ensure timely completion of tasks. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and accuracy in accounting processes. ⚠️ Note This is a pooling role. Final assignment to a specific accounting process (e.g., Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Accounting, etc.) will be determined based on assessment during the Level 1 interview and business needs.

Program Implementation Manages the logistical and administrative requirements necessary for smooth program operations Coordinates venue reservations and logistical setups for all program activities Coordinates and negotiates with faculty members on matters related to student enlistment, scheduling, and room assignments Receives and verifies grade submissions from faculty members and posts the grades in the system Sources, selects, and orients program facilitators and resource persons Mentors individual students and/or student groups, as applicable to the program Develops activities and sessions to help students with their role in the program Provides individual consultation sessions to guide them in their role in the program Monitors the financial requirements of assigned formation programs to ensure adherence to approved budgets Consolidates budget proposals from partner offices for assigned year-level programs Monitors the utilization of program budgets and tracks expenses throughout the year Monitors the financial status of assigned programs through Integrated Ateneo Formation (InAF) DCBs and reviews related budgetary requirements Reviews and monitors the processing of liquidations for assigned year-level programs Processes requests for compensation of facilitators and deliverers, as applicable III. Stakeholder Engagement Serves as the primary point of contact for formation program-related inquiries for assigned year levels, acting as the initial touchpoint for offices, students, and external organizations Identifies and engages potential partners, including academic institutions, organizations, and training providers, to expand formation program offerings and initiatives Represents the assigned formation programs in University-related gatherings and meetings V. Performs other duties as may be assigned by the immediate supervisor, or any authorized representative

deskripsi_pekerjaan: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior UX Designer to join our dynamic product team. In this role, you will be instrumental in prototyping, shipping, and iterating the designs for our products. Conduct user research and apply findings to inform and validate design decisions. Create wireframes, sitemaps, and prototypes to effectively communicate design ideas. Knowledge of AI-assisted design workflows and practical experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI platforms to enhance UX research, content creation, design exploration, and productivity is a plus.
