nama_pekerjaan: IT Service Desk and Deskside Support Assistant
deskripsi_pekerjaan: Under the supervision of the IT Service Desk Lead, IT Service Desk and Deskside Support Assistant serves as the first point of contact for end-user support and for reporting service requests and incidents. The position also provides technology-based deskside system support for all client computing needs. Main Duties and Responsibilities I. Service Desk Operations Logs, classifies, and encodes the incidents or service requests on the ITSM ticketing tool, ensuring that ticket requests are worked on in compliance with the Service Level Agreements. Attends to all end-user requests with accurate and appropriate information in a timely manner, monitoring all service requests and incidents until their resolution. Registers incidents and service requests into the Incident Management Database. Analyzes customer requests for correct classification and provides first-level technical support and resolution. Routes service requests to support groups when incidents are not closed. Assists in the preparation of staff schedules to ensure the service desk is staffed appropriately to cover all hours of operations. Assists the IT Service Desk Lead in attending to the day-to-day operational requirements of the Section. Prepares periodic and ad hoc reports required by the management team. II. Incident Management Resolves and recovers incidents not assigned to second-line support. Keeps affected partners informed about the progress. Resolves or escalates incidents and requests in line with established service level agreements. Escalates the process as necessary per established escalation policies. Logs and records all reported incidents into the Incident Management Database. Monitors the status and progress towards the resolution of assigned incidents. Updates from the Service Desk regarding incident progress Analyzes incident trends and creates knowledge database for known errors. III. Technical Assistance and Support Attends to Video Conferencing Events, Live Streaming, and Video Conferencing Shared Services requirements. Guides users on how to use the Learning Management System and other productivity tools (e.g., Google Suite, Microsoft Office, other Software as a Service [SaaS], etc.). Familiarizes the technical manuals of the different IT assets managed by the university. Provides technical assistance and support by guiding users on how to investigate and conduct basic IT diagnostics as a first-level response to resolving their IT problems (e.g., login problems, software errors, and hardware malfunctions). Regularly documents technical issues, resolutions, and support provided, and creates user manuals or guides for commonly asked questions and resolved issues. Updates the asset inventory and reflects all the related incidents and changes made to the asset. IV. Performs other work-related tasks as may be required by the immediate supervisor and authorized representatives.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Why Join the Mentor Pool? We're building a community of industry practitioners who are passionate about helping others grow. As an Eskwelabs Mentor, you'll guide learners as they apply real-world concepts through hands-on projects, coaching, and feedback in our part-time learning programs. Joining the Mentor Pool gives you access to recurring mentorship opportunities across Eskwelabs' learning programs. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in projects based on their expertise, availability, and program needs. About the Role What You'll Teach You will guide learners in executing core Digital Marketing frameworks and strategic campaigns. You will coach learners on implementing data-driven SEO strategies to improve search rankings. You will help learners master GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) concepts to adapt to AI-driven search behaviors. You will assist learners in analyzing and interpreting campaign data through Marketing Analytics. You will facilitate practical discussions on planning and managing Content Marketing initiatives. You will guide learners in building and optimizing impactful Social Media Marketing funnels. You will coach learners on collaborating with creators and executing Influencer Marketing tactics. Sample Learning Sprint You will guide learners during weekly workshops as they apply digital marketing concepts to real-world scenarios. You will coach small groups of learners by answering their practical questions and unblocking project execution. You will provide specific, actionable feedback on learner projects and milestone submissions throughout the week. You will encourage learner confidence, persistence, and collaboration within our community communication channels. You will review learner progress data to identify common bottlenecks and offer targeted mentorship support. What we're looking for We're looking for industry practitioners who enjoy sharing their expertise and helping others learn. Professional teaching experience is welcome but not required. We value real-world experience, curiosity, and a willingness to coach others. What you'll do Coach learners through hands-on projects. Provide timely, actionable feedback. Answer learner questions and unblock challenges. Share industry best practices and encourage collaboration. What you won't do You will not be expected to: Create learning materials from scratch. Deliver full lectures or develop curriculum. Complete work outside agreed mentorship commitments. Participate in on-site sessions unless you choose to join projects that require them. What you'll gain Earn through flexible paid mentorship opportunities. Develop your coaching and leadership skills. Collaborate with experienced educators and practitioners. Access Eskwelabs learning resources and professional development. Work Arrangement Project assignments may be conducted remotely, onsite, or in a hybrid setup depending on the needs of each learning program. How to Apply Applications for this role are managed through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form. Click Apply to be redirected to our official application portal. As part of the application process, you will be asked to: Complete a short application form Upload your resume Share your professional background and mentoring experience Choose your preferred assessment pathway (Fireside Chat or Video Submission) Only applications submitted through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form will be reviewed.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Main Duties and Responsibilities: I. Marketing Management Keeps track of updates and developments that affect the University as a research institution, including how its counterparts are marketing its products. Conducts market research and analyzes industry trends to develop innovative distribution networks. Keeps track of publication distributor and consumer behaviors, coming up with proactive solutions on how to turn leads to actual sales. Regularly provides data that would show a picture of the distributor and consumer profiles and dynamics, including forecasts on short- and long-term horizons to help the University Press prepare for the future publications, in coordination with the different University Press sections Prepares quarterly and yearly marketing insight reports, in coordination with the different University Press administrators, and designs a program to communicate such data to concerned sections. Consolidates the year-end reports for discussion with the University Press leadership team, and provides marketing-related recommendations on how to address such realities and needs. Meets with the University Press’ leadership team regularly to help identify marketing requirements, including providing feedback on the market temperaments and preferences. Designs and oversees the implementation of a comprehensive marketing and promotions plan for the University Press to synergize and energize lead generation and conversion, and ensure that there will be steady and sustainable growth in terms of sales distribution and stock movements. Aligns all strategic marketing efforts with the Director. Establishes metrics and quality measures to determine the progress of the marketing initiatives, while regularly checking, monitoring, and evaluating the progress and achievement of agreed deliverables and timelines. Recommends and implements an aggressive marketing plan, based on projected and actual market trends. Develops a freelance sales force for University Press textbooks. Plans and oversees a systematic and targeted promotions and communication campaign across various publication and media channels targeting local and international markets. Schedules and coordinates University Press exhibits/sales with various conference organizers. Coordinates book launches and events with the Head of Business and Operations. Plans and supervises the stand and display at the annual Manila International Book Fair. Oversees and manages the University Press’ social media accounts. Develops and implements strategies to cultivate relationships with distributors and sales channels, including planning and facilitating activities and events to initiate and maintain contact. II. Section Management and Development Sets the direction of the Marketing Section and establishes operational goals aligned with the University Press goals, and University mandates. Develops Section management policies, which includes marketing policies, and contributes to the development of general University Press policies. Oversees and coordinates day-to-day operations, determining the workflow of the marketing process. Prepares and monitors the Section's budget and expenses, recommending cost-effective solutions for the University Press. Manages performance of employees in the Section by setting standards/targets, monitoring and evaluating performance, and providing development opportunities Recruits, builds, manages, and mentors staff that will form part of the Marketing Section. III. Performs all other tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor and authorized representatives.

Inventory Management: Analyze monthly inventory and three-month average sales to identify Months to Sell (MTS). Facilitate the repeat of available stocks from the warehouse and pull-out from other stores based on demand. Identify and consolidate low and broken on-hand quantities per style in all stores to the store with the highest sales demand. Support markdown strategies based on a markdown calendar and propose markdowns based on remaining on-hand quantities and sell-through rates. Competitors Check: Conduct regular competitor checks through online research and physical store visits.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Description The job of Accounting Associate is established for the purpose of supplying administrative support to Vessel Accountants being in the Philippines by performing clerical tasks such as preparing voucher documentation, filing, document balances as part of closing routines, basic bookkeeping, paying vendors, invoice customers, posting of invoices and other ad hoc tasks. Main Tasks: Prepare, review, and maintain accounting vouchers and supporting workpapers as the basis for general ledger entries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, proper accounting treatment, and compliance with internal control requirements and company policies. Maintain and oversee the organization of financial records and supporting documentation, ensuring proper documentation, accessibility, retention, and compliance with established records management and audit requirements. Perform quarterly balance sheet account reconciliation activities across assigned entities, including analysis of account movements, identification of aged or unusual items, investigation of variances, and timely resolution or escalation of reconciling items. Perform end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting activities for assigned entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions and appropriate recognition of costs in accordance with accounting policies. Monitor and manage the vendor invoice lifecycle, including follow-up on outstanding invoices, resolution of invoice-related issues, coordination with vendors and internal stakeholders, and timely processing to support accurate period-end closing and payment. Prepare and process customer billing and invoices, ensuring appropriate supporting documentation, accurate accounting information, adherence to contractual requirements, and compliance with internal controls and billing procedures. Perform review, validation, and posting of invoices and accounting transactions in the financial system, ensuring appropriate coding, supporting documentation, tax treatment, and accurate recognition in the correct accounting period. Execute accounts payable activities for assigned entities, ensuring timely and compliant processing of transactions, accurate vendor balances, proper application of accounting and tax requirements, and adherence to company policies and month-end closing timelines. Coordinate and support vendor master data management, including vendor onboarding, validation, maintenance, and periodic review, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, appropriate documentation, and compliance with internal control and regulatory requirements. Perform accounting analysis and investigate discrepancies or exceptions identified during transaction processing, reconciliations, and month-end activities, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution and appropriate accounting treatment. Support month-end and quarterly closing activities by completing assigned reconciliations, accruals, reclassifications, invoice processing, and other closing requirements within established deadlines and quality standards. Identify recurring accounting issues and control gaps and recommend practical improvements to strengthen process efficiency, data quality, internal controls, and the overall accuracy of financial reporting. Act as a key point of contact for routine accounting matters for assigned entities, vendors, and internal stakeholders, providing timely clarification and resolving issues within the scope of responsibility while escalating complex matters when required. Contribute to process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives within Vessel Accounting, including documentation of procedures, identification of inefficiencies, and implementation of agreed improvements.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Summary The Senior Graphic Design Officer is responsible for leading the visual execution of brand, marketing, and e-commerce initiatives across digital and physical touchpoints. This role oversees campaign design from concept to execution, ensures brand consistency, and collaborates closely with cross-functional teams including Marketing, E-commerce, Visual Merchandising, Production, and external suppliers. The position combines creative leadership, hands-on design work, and project coordination to deliver high-quality visual materials for both B2C and B2B needs. Key Responsibilities Campaign & E-commerce Design Oversee e-commerce campaign layouts from moodboarding through final execution. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across all campaign assets. Design and review marketplace wireframes, product postings, newsletters, and other e-commerce materials. Collaborate with Shopify developers to ensure website layouts and designs are accurately implemented using tools such as Figma . Team Leadership & Task Delegation Delegate graphic design tasks to the creative team and monitor progress to ensure deadlines and quality standards are met. Manage daily design requests from Marketing, Visual Merchandising, E-commerce, and other departments such as HR, Export, or Operations. Marketing & Branding Materials Create and oversee marketing materials for collection launches, including website wireframes/designs, social media posts and carousels, newsletters, stories, GIFs, and AI-assisted creative assets. Develop branding and promotional materials such as newsletters, static or carousel posts, GIFs, stories, and mall mileage assets (digital and offline). Utilize AI generation tools to support concept development, visual exploration, and content creation while maintaining brand consistency. Visual Merchandising & In-Store Graphics Support Visual Merchandising requirements by creating and overseeing in-store graphics, including shelf graphics, promo easels, standees, table graphics, window banners, window plotting, and store plotting. Ensure in-store visuals align with brand identity and campaign messaging. Print & Production Coordination Coordinate with suppliers and printers for all print jobs, from prototype and sample development to mass production. Create and oversee printed materials such as magazines, flyers, postcards, gift vouchers, and gift cards. Review proofs, manage timelines, and ensure quality control throughout the production process. Photoshoot & Content Production Assist the Production team during photoshoots. Create moodboards and shot lists for campaign photoshoots as needed, including AI-assisted visual references when appropriate. Provide on-site support and coordinate with photographers to ensure all required shots are captured. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with copywriters, marketing officers, marketing assistants, and other stakeholders to align visuals with messaging and campaign goals. Collaborate across departments to deliver creative solutions for both B2C and B2B materials.

Resource Management Support Manages the inventory and procurement of athletic equipment and supplies to ensure continuous availability and maintain items in good working condition Coordinates with external suppliers and service providers for procurement of equipment and supplies Monitors and tracks the department budget and financial resources to ensure transparency and adherence to approved allocations III. Athlete Welfare Support Serves as a point of contact for student-athletes, coaches, and parents, receiving and addressing concerns and facilitating appropriate support and referrals Coordinates with relevant University offices and stakeholders to facilitate the resolution of student-athlete concerns related to academic, personal, welfare, and athletics-related matters Coordinates with relevant stakeholders to support student-athlete welfare, academic development, and overall student experience Monitors student-athlete academic progress and coordinates academic support initiatives, including tutorials, mentoring programs, eligibility requirements, and transition activities across educational levels and athletics programs IV. deskripsi_pekerjaan: Job Description The Accounting Analyst is responsible for delivering high-quality accounting, and control activities across assigned entities. The role provides end-to-end accounting support, ensures compliance with internal control frameworks, and performs analytical review and validation of financial data to support accurate and timely reporting. In addition, the role acts as a key coordinator between Corporate Accounting, Group Accounting (Oslo), and external stakeholders, contributing to process improvements, standardisation, and strengthening of financial governance. Principal Tasks: Ensure accurate and timely delivery of accounting and reporting activities in compliance with internal control requirements and corporate policies. Perform review and validation of accounting outputs, identifying risks, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities. Support and drive efficiency, standardization, and continuous process improvements within Corporate Accounting. Act as a key point of coordination between Manila, Oslo Group Accounting, and other stakeholders. Contribute to audit readiness and regulatory compliance, ensuring completeness and quality of documentation. Main Tasks: Accounting & Financial Control Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting documentation with a focus on accuracy, completeness, and compliance. Perform detailed balance sheet reconciliations, including investigation and resolution of variances. Ensure adherence to internal control frameworks and escalate control gaps when identified. Financial Reporting & Analysis Prepare and perform initial review of financial statements and reporting packages prior to submission to Group Accounting. Conduct analytical reviews, identifying trends, material variances, and potential risks. Support quarterly and annual reporting, including coordination with relevant stakeholders. Transaction Processing Oversight Process and validate vendor invoices and customer billing with a focus on compliance and accuracy. Monitor receivables and support collection efforts to ensure timely cash flow. Oversee posting activities (including IFS), ensuring correctness and completeness. Payments & Treasury Support Prepare and review payment proposals in line with GMS payment procedures. Perform and review bank reconciliations, ensuring timely resolution of reconciling items. Quality Assurance & Governance Perform quality checks on selected tasks completed by Corporate Accountants. Identify and recommend process enhancements and internal control improvements. Support audit processes by coordinating requirements and ensuring readiness. Cross-functional & International Support Coordinate with Group Accounting (Oslo), project teams, and Colombia Accounting team on deliverables. Provide guidance and support to junior team members and stakeholders. Participate in process improvement and system initiatives (e.g., ERP/IFS enhancements).

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Summary Project Scope The Project Staff will support the implementation of SQMO' data management’s mandate to strengthen institutional data management for key decision-makers and University stakeholders. This project aims to improve the collection, processing, analysis, visualization, and documentation of institutional data by developing user-centered dashboards, reports, and supporting resources that provide accurate, aligned, and actionable information for evidence-based decision-making across the University. The Project Staff will primarily assist in gathering and processing data, and transforming data into insightful information through the creation of University dashboards, as well as documenting dashboard guides for the University's stakeholders, under the guidance of the Data Management Head and in close collaboration with other members of the Data Management Team. Principal Accountabilities: Gather, clean, validate, and consolidate institutional data from various University units and data sources. Process, organize, and maintain datasets to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Assist in the analysis and interpretation of institutional data to identify key trends, patterns, and insights. Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and data visualizations. Prepare summary reports and analytical narratives that communicate key findings, highlights, trends, and potential areas of concern. Develop and update dashboard documentation, user guides,, and other reference materials. Assist in monitoring data quality by identifying inconsistencies, validating outputs, and recommending corrective actions. Collaborate with the Data Management Head and members of the Data Management Team in implementing data management initiatives and continuously improving reporting processes. Perform other data management and analytics-related tasks as may be assigned in support of SQMO initiatives. Project Deliverables: Cleaned, validated, and organized institutional datasets ready for analysis and reporting. Interactive dashboards and data visualizations supporting institutional monitoring and strategic decision-making. Summary reports highlighting key findings, trends, patterns, and insights from institutional data. Dashboard user guides, documentation, and reference materials for University stakeholders. Timely completion of assigned data processing, analytics, visualization, and documentation outputs in accordance with project timelines.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: Why Join the Mentor Pool? We're building a community of industry practitioners who are passionate about helping others grow. As an Eskwelabs Mentor, you'll guide learners as they apply real-world concepts through hands-on projects, coaching, and feedback in our part-time learning programs. Joining the Mentor Pool gives you access to recurring mentorship opportunities across Eskwelabs' learning programs. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in projects based on their expertise, availability, and program needs. About the Role What we're looking for We're looking for professionals who enjoy sharing their expertise and helping others learn. You don't need to be a professional educator. Many of our mentors come directly from industry and bring valuable real-world experience into the classroom. If you're passionate about coaching others and continuously learning yourself, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll do Coach learners as they work through hands-on projects and practical activities. Answer learner questions and help unblock technical or strategic challenges. Provide constructive, actionable feedback that supports learner growth. Encourage collaboration, confidence, and a positive learning experience. Share industry insights and real-world best practices. What you won't do We recognize that our mentors are busy professionals, so we've designed the role to fit alongside your existing commitments. You will not be expected to: Create learning materials from scratch. Deliver full lectures or develop curriculum. Complete work outside agreed mentorship commitments. Participate in on-site sessions unless you choose to join projects that require them. What you'll gain Inspire professionals as they build practical, future-ready skills. Develop your leadership, coaching, and mentoring abilities. Collaborate with experienced educators and industry practitioners. Access Eskwelabs learning materials and professional development resources. Enjoy flexible project-based engagements that fit alongside your career. Earn additional income through paid mentorship opportunities. Work Arrangement Project assignments may be conducted remotely, onsite, or in a hybrid setup depending on the needs of each learning program. How to Apply Applications for this role are managed through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form. Click Apply to be redirected to our official application portal. As part of the application process, you will be asked to: Complete a short application form Upload your resume Share your professional background and mentoring experience Choose your preferred assessment pathway (Fireside Chat or Video Submission) Only applications submitted through the Eskwelabs Educator Application Form will be reviewed.

nama_pekerjaan: Registered Dietitian for Weight Management Program
deskripsi_pekerjaan: About the Program Our GLP-1 program supports patients on GLP-1 for weight management. Most GLP-1 patients in the Philippines are injecting with very little nutrition support — that gap is the job. You'll work alongside our prescribing physicians from first titration through maintenance. All consultations are online. What You'll Do Conduct nutrition assessments and build individualized care plans via teleconsultation; adjust at every dose escalation. Set and monitor protein targets to protect muscle and bone during rapid weight loss, and watch for micronutrient deficiency risk (vitamin D, calcium, B12, iron). Endorse supplementation or labs to the physician as indicated. Build plans around how Filipinos actually eat — rice as the dietary center, affordable local proteins (isda, manok, itlog, tokwa, monggo), merienda patterns, and handaan. Manage GI side effects — nausea, vomiting, constipation, LBM, reflux, early satiety — by adjusting meal timing, texture, volume, and fiber. Escalate red flags to the physician immediately. Prepare patients nutritionally for dose reductions and discontinuation driven by cost, supply, or HMO denial, well before they happen. Reinforce cold-chain storage (2–8°C) during brownouts and travel. Escalate immediately if a patient reports sourcing from unregistered sellers. Use motivational interviewing to build habits that hold post-medication; screen for disordered eating and refer out. Use the camera deliberately — ref and pantry walkthroughs, label reading, portions on the patient's own plates. Manage asynchronous follow-up between consults. Document in the EMR and practice per DOH telemedicine guidelines and the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) — approved platforms only.

The role encompasses generating and developing customer pipelines, engaging customers, acquiring and managing assigned accounts and leads, managing contracts, closing opportunities, and providing after-sales customer support. These insights contribute to the continuous enhancement of Pi Energy’s products, solutions, and value propositions. Also ensure that the proposal is aligned with the customer’s budget, if possible. Conduct contract-related due diligence/risk management compliance, communicate significant findings in collaboration with the Business Development teams. Serve as the primary First Gen / Pi Energy representative to various institutions to build connections and facilitate business growth. deskripsi_pekerjaan: General Function The Product Specialist will play a vital role in driving sales through product expertise, training, and active engagement with sales teams and clients. This role involves mastering every facet of the assigned product line—including features, specifications, applications, and competitive positioning—while collaborating with sales teams to promote and increase product adoption. The ideal candidate is highly proactive, deeply knowledgeable, and able to present products persuasively to enhance sales performance and market reach. Specific Duties Key Responsibilities: Develop Product Mastery: Fully understand and document the features, configurations, options, pricing, and competitive positioning of assigned products. Continually assess market trends, clinical applications, and customer needs to stay informed on new developments. Sales Enablement: Work closely with sales staff to provide the insights and tools necessary to promote assigned products effectively. Actively encourage and assist sales teams to drive product sales through ongoing support, training sessions, and persuasive presentations. Market Analysis: Conduct thorough research on competitive products and market data, including installed base statistics, to position products optimally in the market and support sales strategies. Presentation Skills: Prepare and deliver convincing product presentations tailored to management, colleagues, sales teams, and customers, fostering interest and engagement with the product. Marketing Support: Assist during company marketing initiatives, such as trade exhibits, field promotions, and other activities, to showcase the product’s value and drive customer interest. Cross-functional Collaboration: Provide service marketing and administrative support, ensuring cohesive alignment across departments to boost overall product success. Training and Development: Attend all relevant training and seminars, both locally and internationally, to ensure product knowledge remains current and competitive. Leadership in Product Marketing: Take charge of marketing activities directly related to the assigned product, coordinating with other teams to amplify product reach. Additional Duties: Perform other sales, marketing, and administrative support functions as needed to drive product growth.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: 20,000 doctors. Millions of patients. A lean design team — soon to be more. SeriousMD is the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust most. NowServing connects patients to providers across the country. Together, we're reshaping how healthcare works in the Philippines and design is at the center of it. Our design team is intentionally small and senior. No bureaucracy, no design-by-committee. Your decisions ship and get tested by real users almost immediately. We need a Design Lead to own design strategy and build this team intentionally. About Us Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD and NowServing — healthcare products used daily by 20,000+ doctors and millions of patients. Our design decisions directly impact how physicians manage patient records, how clinics run their schedules, and how patients find and book care. This isn't abstract "healthcare technology." It's real workflows, real people, real consequences. What You'll Actually Do Lead and grow the design team. Today that's one designer who knows our products deeply. Tomorrow it's the team you build. Own design strategy across SeriousMD (B2B EMR) and NowServing (patient marketplace). Stay hands-on — you'll still design, not just manage. Work directly with product and engineering to ship features weekly, not quarterly. Run user research with actual doctors and patients — not personas, real people. Build and maintain design systems that scale across web, iOS, and Android. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) A team that values craft and impact over process and theater How to Apply Send your portfolio and a short note about why healthcare design interests you. Bonus points if you include one thing you'd change about SeriousMD or NowServing after looking at them.

deskripsi_pekerjaan: The Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer/Technical Consultant is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering technical solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (D365 BC). The role involves customizing and extending Business Central functionality, integrating the system with internal and external applications, and supporting end-to-end implementation for various clients. The consultant ensures solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives across digital transformation initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Design & Development Design and develop extensions, custom modules, and enhancements for Dynamics 365 Business Central using AL language in Visual Studio Code. Customize standard BC functionalities according to business and client requirements. Build efficient and reusable technical solutions aligned with industry best practices. 2. Technical Consulting & Requirements Analysis Collaborate with business analysts, SMEs, and stakeholders to analyze requirements and translate them into technical specifications. Recommend system improvements, architectural approaches, and configuration options based on business needs. Conduct feasibility analysis for new features, integrations, and process improvements. 3. System Integration & API Development Develop integrations using Business Central APIs, web services (SOAP/REST), and custom connectors. Coordinate with internal technical teams to integrate BC with ERP components, finance systems, HRIS, CRM tools, or third-party applications. Ensure stable, secure, and efficient data flow across systems. 4. SQL & Data Management Work with SQL databases for data migration, reporting, and backend processes. Execute data transformation, cleansing, and migration during implementation or upgrades. Troubleshoot data inconsistencies and optimize query performance. 5. Implementation & Deployment Support full lifecycle implementation—from system configuration to testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and UAT assistance. Prepare and maintain technical documentation. 6. Ongoing Support & Maintenance Provide Level 2/3 technical support for Business Central environment issues. Troubleshoot performance issues, bugs, and configuration challenges. Deliver system training or technical guidance to internal teams or external clients when required. 7. Collaboration & Project Delivery Work closely with cross-functional teams across Yondu or NCS, including Delivery, PMO, QA, and Business Units. Ensure all deliverables follow standards, timelines, and quality guidelines. Participate in Agile ceremonies or project meetings as needed.

Support in the Implementation of backup processes aligning with business recovery policies and manage database access. Diagnose and troubleshoot database errors, recommending and implementing emerging technologies. Create and manage advanced database reports, visualizations, and dashboards.
